Dosal Tobacco Corporation, an ISO 9001 certified company, is seeking a Procurement Officer. With half a century of experience in the United States, our brands have become respected and well known for providing premium-quality tobacco products.

This position is responsible for the procurement of a wide range of commodities, products and services; preparing, soliciting and analyzing quotations, delivery terms and availability; negotiating costs; and conducting sourcing and support activities.

Pay: Up to $70k / year + bonus

Lambrakos Studio is an award-winning, progressive, collaborative design practice specializing in singular residential and commercial spaces. Located in the Arts District near Houston Heights, we are seeking a highly organized Procurement Manager who thrives in a fast-paced, creative environment.

About the Role

The Procurement Manager connects our creative vision with successful project execution, overseeing the procurement process from designer specification through final installation across residential and commercial projects.

This role manages purchasing, vendor relationships, budgets, order tracking, and delivery logistics. The ideal candidate anticipates issues, protects project profitability, and ensures that every item meets the studio’s quality standards and project requirements.

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic Sourcing & Vendor Management

* **Vendor relationships:** Build and maintain relationships with manufacturers, showrooms, artisans, and tradespeople; negotiate trade pricing, payment terms, and delivery arrangements.
* **Value engineering:** Identify alternative products or materials that support the client’s budget and timeline while preserving design intent, subject to designer approval.
* **Custom fabrication:** Coordinate with drapery, upholstery, cabinetry, and other custom workrooms to ensure specifications, measurements, and required approvals are complete before production begins.

Financial Management & Budgeting

* **Estimating and proposals:** Translate designer specifications into detailed, itemized budgets and client proposals, including product costs, freight, crating, warehousing, delivery, and installation.
* **Purchase orders:** Create, issue, and maintain accurate purchase orders for furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E); track order confirmations and changes.
* **Invoice and payment tracking:** Reconcile vendor invoices against approved quotes and purchase orders, coordinate payment approvals, and verify that required client approvals and deposits are received before orders are placed.
* **Cost control:** Track procurement expenses, identify discrepancies, and ensure applicable freight, storage, delivery, and installation charges are accurately billed to clients.

Logistics & Expediting

* **Procurement scheduling:** Develop and maintain procurement schedules aligned with construction milestones and installation dates, accounting for production lead times and shipping requirements.
* **Order tracking:** Review open orders weekly, confirm production and shipping status, and proactively communicate delays and proposed solutions.
* **Freight and warehousing:** Coordinate with freight providers, third-party receivers, and warehouses to ensure items are inspected, documented, stored, and delivered appropriately.
* **Project coordination:** Keep designers and relevant project team members informed of order status, outstanding decisions, and issues affecting budgets or schedules.

Quality Control & Installation

* **Submittal coordination:** Review shop drawings, finish samples, and fabric strike-offs for consistency with specifications; obtain designer approval before authorizing production.
* **Damage claims:** Manage damage and deficiency claims, including documentation, vendor communication, repairs, replacements, and resolution tracking.
* **Installation coordination:** Coordinate on-site deliveries and direct movers in accordance with approved floor plans and designer direction.
* **Project closeout:** Track outstanding items and resolve procurement-related punch-list issues following installation.

Required Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with purchasing, invoicing, basic bookkeeping, or financial tracking.
* Professional, responsive communication with clients, vendors, and project teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Three to five years of procurement, purchasing, or project coordination experience in interior design, architecture, or a related field.
* Associate degree or coursework in business administration, interior design, or a related discipline.
* Familiarity with Houzz, CRM systems, and project management software.
* Knowledge of design terminology, materials, custom fabrication, and vendor relationships.
* Understanding of residential and/or commercial interior design workflows, from specification through installation.

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive compensation based on experience.

* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* An inclusive, creative, collaborative studio culture where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone is encouraged to contribute.
* A flexible, supportive work environment that balances individual needs with project deadlines and client commitments.

The Sr Produce Buyer will utilize their category expertise and vendor specific knowledge to manage inventory levels for all assigned items, suppliers and/or categories while maintaining service level and spoilage targets to our customers across multiple distribution centers. Responsible for delivering forecast accuracy and forecasting per defined goals by SKU and/or product family. Collaborate with Logistics Operations, Produce Category Management, markets and Suppliers to understand USF optimized supply chain opportunities.

This role will be onsite 2 days a month. Candidates will need to reside within one of the 3 areas: Lenexa, Kansas, Grand Island, North Dakota or Omaha, Nebraska.

**Job Responsibilities**

Delivers on KPIs for desk specific goals such as: Service Level, Days-Inventory-On-Hand (DIOH), spoilage and freight income.  
  
Proactively reviews projected out of stock report daily to ensure we deliver on customer order fulfillment.  
  
Analyzes economic order quantities, forecasts, lead times, vendor set-up, safety stock, etc., in-order to create efficient purchase orders with our suppliers.  
  
Communicates closely with our cross-functional partners to capture seasonal trends and events in the business as well as drive profitability with accurate costs.  
  
Partners appropriately with product/category management team to maintain supplier relationships and proper accountability.  
  
Cooperates with the logistics team to identify and achieve freight consolidation to maximize net income.  
  
Point person for all third party logistic managed loads.  
  
Evaluates inbound volume and purchase history to collaborate with warehouse operations on efficient receiving practices.  
  
Executes forward-buy opportunities to achieve profitability for period or year-end based on targeted goals.  
  
Confirm all purchase orders accurately using vendor confirmation as well verifying this cost using the loaded vendor price list.  
  
Clear any costing discrepancies between the received PO’s and the vendor invoice, through the Buyer Match Pay process by 8 pm each Wednesday.  
  
Work with vendors to reconcile any discrepancies. Achieve PO Cost Accuracy % on the Buyer KPI scorecard  
  
Review all daily cost exception reports and take appropriate action to insure all costing data is accurate and up to date, including:  
  
Review Last Cost Reasonableness report and resolve any issues  
  
Last Invoice Cost to Total Market Cost variances  
  
Weekly review of the Last Invoice Cost Book report and resolve issues  
  
Inventory revaluation report including auditing any inventory gains  
  
Set-up new item cost attributes to reflect accurate inbound cost  
  
Review PO timing to identify and mitigate impact of LPM / LPW costs  
  
Review PO freight costs for appropriateness and address issues with the appropriate stakeholder (ie, incorrect freight on PO, freight rate issues.  
  
Maintain up-to-date and accurate freight information and maintain control of the freight rate process utilizing the Network Strategy Rate  
  
Maintenance team and produce replenishment. Obtain current transportation market data to update rate information based on industry trends or cost increases.  
  
Proactively ensure the accurate development of demand data based upon forecast, current inventory targets, replenishment lead-time and master data settings. Interpret and report forecast implications of phasing-in/out of items. Full ownership of forecasting of your desk.

**Work Environment:**

Hybrid: This role is partially remote, and the associate is expected to perform assigned responsibilities from a combined home-based and office-based environment.

**Related Experience/Requirements:**  
Minimum 4 years of purchasing, and/or related work in the procurement or logistics field, produce experience preferred. Prior experience working in a large fast paced foodservice purchasing and/or logistics environment strongly desired  
  
**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**
  
Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills, excellent analytical skills, demonstrate a keen attention to detail, strong interpersonal skills, be able to communicate with vendors and across cross-functional. Knowledge of freight concepts and vendor pricing preferred. Must be able to manage successful relationships with product and transportation providers/suppliers.
  
  
Proficiency required in the use of Microsoft Office especially Microsoft Word and Excel, as well as Microsoft Outlook. PRISM and E3/AWR experience preferred

This role will also receive annual incentive plan bonus .

**MANTECH** seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented **Senior Procurement Analyst** to join our team in **Chantilly, VA**.

  

This role supports critical logistics and procurement operations by providing full-spectrum support in warehouse and procurement management. You will bring your experience and dedication to maintaining equipment accountability and drive process improvements in accordance with MANTECH and customer standards.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

  

* Manage and coordinate procurement purchases, track warranties, and create or reconcile purchase requests and orders using government financial tools such as FOCUS, ESAM, and SAP.
* Review and approve quotes, create DD250 and DD1149 forms for equipment transfers, and support Engineering in gathering information for new equipment.
* Manage and control government property, ensuring 100% inventory tracking, accountability, and verification of records in the SAP database.
* Create, update, and implement procurement support Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) detailing asset management, warranty, and inventory control.
* Conduct periodic inventory sampling, handle shipping and receiving in compliance with procedures, and execute strategies to address audit findings.
* Maintain detailed accounting of all temporary and permanent transfers of government property using applicable documentation, directives, and customer instructions.
* Track procurements and delivery dates proactively while updating material tracking databases to generate monthly Customer Acquired Property Reports and provide real-time status updates.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or 4+ additional years of additional work experience in lieu of a degree
* 5+ years of logistics experience, preferably supporting the U.S. Government.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Excel and familiarity with industry and government logistics and property accountability regulations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to maintain effective vendor and customer relationships.
* DoD 8570 IAT Level 2 certification (e.g., Security+, CCNA Security) or the ability to obtain it within 6 months of hire.
* Ability to travel up to 25% within the Continental U.S.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience utilizing government financial and asset tracking tools including FOCUS, ESAM, and SAP.
* Proven ability to maintain current SAP certifications and lead inventory control processes.

**Clearance Requirements:**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen with an active Top Secret / SCI clearance with Polygraph.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to walk for long periods within a warehouse or customer workplace setting to conduct inventories and inspect equipment.
* Must be able to perform physical actions such as bending, squatting, and maneuvering around crowded locations during inspections.
* Must be able to lift and move equipment and boxes weighing up to 50 lbs.
* Must be able to operate a computer and other standard office productivity equipment.

ASRC Federal is seeking a Senior Buyer to support procurement activities for the U.S. Army Ground Vehicle Systems Center (GVSC). This position will report directly to the ASRC Federal Procurement team and will operate in close coordination with project and technical staff supporting GVSC programs. The role may be based in Sterling Heights, MI or Reston, VA and will function in a hybrid work environment.
  
  
**Work location:** Hybrid (candidate must be located in Sterling Height, MI or Reston, VA)
  
  
**Summary:** The Senior Buyer is responsible for executing a wide range of Federal procurement actions in support of GVSC requirements. Working under the direction of the ASRC Federal Procurement organization, this role ensures compliant, timely, and cost- effective purchasing of materials, supplies, equipment, and services in accordance with the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), contract requirements, and internal ASRC Federal policies.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Review and analyze Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for accuracy, authorization, specifications, delivery requirements, and compliance with contract and FAR requirements.
* Perform proactive sourcing to identify qualified suppliers, improve lead times, reduce costs, and enhance supply chain reliability.
* Develop and issue Requests for Quotation (RFQs) to qualified suppliers; evaluate supplier responses for price, delivery, technical compliance, and risk.
* Award and administer Purchase Orders (POs) for materials, equipment, supplies, and commercial services in accordance with FAR, DFARS, and ASRC Federal procurement procedures.
* Conduct price analysis and determine fair and reasonable pricing; document all analysis and procurement decisions in accordance with Federal and corporate standards.
* Maintain fully compliant procurement files, ensuring documentation meets all Government and internal audit requirements.
* Track and manage the status of open POs; communicate updates to internal stakeholders and resolve issues related to delivery, quality, or supplier performance.
* Coordinate with suppliers to follow up on overdue deliveries, resolve discrepancies, and support continuous improvement in supplier performance.
* Collaborate with Accounts Payable and Project Control Analysts to reconcile invoices, resolve discrepancies, and process PO modifications for credits, returns, or scope changes.
* Utilize Costpoint and other procurement systems to process requisitions, issue POs, track shipments, and maintain procurement records.
* Maintain effective communication with internal customers to ensure procurement actions aligned with program schedules and technical requirements.
* Support reporting requirements for procurement status, open actions, and compliance metrics to ASRC Federal Procurement leadership.

Requirements
  

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5+ years of relevant procurement experience, including Federal procurement.
* 3–5 years of experience executing FAR based purchases, including documentation, compliance, and audit ready file management.
* Experience with USG commercial purchasing procedures and supplier sourcing.
* Ability to execute a multitude of procurement instruments (BOAs, POs, etc).
* Knowledge of supply sources and ability to identify and qualify vendors.
* Must be a U.S. citizenship is required to support this program.
* Must successfully complete a background check.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Familiarity with Government approved purchasing systems and compliant procurement workflows.
* Experience using Deltek Costpoint for procurement, receiving, and PO administration.
* Strong time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing deadlines.
* Knowledge of the automotive industry, including relevant suppliers, materials, and manufacturing support vendors.
* Demonstrated ability in term negotiation, including pricing, delivery, and contractual terms.

**Job Summary**

The Purchasing Manager is the highest level individual contributor and functional leader within the purchasing organization, providing enterprise wide leadership for complex procurement activities, strategic sourcing execution, and business unit alignment. This role serves as the primary escalation point for high risk, high value, and highly complex procurement initiatives and acts as a trusted advisor to senior business, operational, and supply chain leadership.  
  
The Purchasing Manager leads cross functional sourcing strategies, mentors procurement professionals, drives continuous improvement of purchasing processes, and ensures alignment with corporate objectives, risk management requirements, and long term supply strategies.

**Job Description**

Where Putting the Customer First Powers Everything We Do!

**What You'll Do:**

**Enterprise Purchasing Leadership**

  

* Provide enterprise level leadership for highly complex, high value, and mission critical purchasing activities across multiple business units.
* Serve as the senior escalation point for purchasing strategy, supplier performance issues, commercial disputes, and contract negotiations.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business unit and senior leadership on purchasing strategy, market conditions, and supply risk.

**Strategic Sourcing & Commercial Excellence**

  

* Lead the development and execution of enterprise sourcing strategies, including competitive sourcing events, long term agreements, and supplier consolidation initiatives.
* Drive complex, high impact negotiations involving pricing, commercial terms, risk allocation, and performance commitments.
* Ensure sourcing strategies align with financial objectives, risk management standards, and operational requirements.

**Cross Functional & Stakeholder Leadership**

  

* Partner closely with Legal, Risk Management, Finance, Engineering, Operations, and Category Management to ensure alignment on contracts, specifications, and commercial strategy.
* Lead and influence cross functional teams without direct authority to achieve purchasing and sourcing objectives.
* Represent the Purchasing organization in senior level discussions, governance forums, and enterprise initiatives.

**Supplier Relationship & Performance Management**

  

* Provide executive level oversight of critical and strategic supplier relationships.
* Guide supplier performance management frameworks, including scorecards, corrective action plans, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support supplier innovation, value creation, and long term partnership development.

**Talent Development & Mentorship**

  

* Serve as a mentor and technical authority for Purchasing Analyst, Senior, and Principal level professionals.
* Provide guidance on complex sourcing strategies, negotiations, and issue resolution.
* Contribute to the development of purchasing standards, best practices, and knowledge sharing across the organization.

**Governance, Risk & Continuous Improvement**

  

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance purchasing processes, tools, and governance.
* Ensure compliance with corporate purchasing policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards.
* Support enterprise initiatives related to cost optimization, risk mitigation, supplier diversity, and operational resilience.

**What We're Looking For:**

**Education/Experience:**

  

Bachelor's degree in related field of study + 8 years of relevant work experience.

(Or) In lieu of Bachelor’s degree must possess an Associate’s degree in related field of study, and a minimum of 10 years of relevant work experience.

(Or) In lieu of Associate’s degree must possess a High School Diploma or equivalent, and a minimum of 12 years of relevant work experience.

**Additional Expectations:**

  

* Minimum of seven (7) years of progressively responsible purchasing or supply chain experience.
* Demonstrated success leading complex sourcing initiatives, enterprise negotiations, and cross functional teams.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive results across multiple business units.
* Experience with Maximo, Ariba, Celonis, and/or Agiloft

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM) or equivalent professional certification.
* Experience leading enterprise level sourcing strategies or major capital and O&M procurement initiatives.
* Advanced negotiation, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills.
* Strong analytical, financial, and risk management acumen.

**Additional Information:**

  

* Travel to business unit facilities, supplier locations, and construction sites may be required.
* May be assigned to support critical operational events, outages, or emergency response activities.
* Expected to lead with a continuous improvement mindset and proactively identify opportunities

**Overview**

The Senior Procurement Analyst leads planning and forecasting for all Sarku Japan restaurants and owns purchasing for everything outside of food and beverage, including non-food supplies, smallwares, equipment, and services. This person turns sales and supply data into clear forecasts so the team knows what volumes are coming, can prepare for limited time offers and menu changes, and keeps restaurants in stock without carrying extra inventory.

The role also builds and manages our supplier base for non-food categories. That means running bids, negotiating pricing and contract terms, and making sure products and services arrive on time, at the right quality, and at the right cost. The Supply Chain Manager reports to the VP of Supply Chain and works closely with Operations, Culinary, Marketing, Finance, and our distribution partners.

**Essential Responsibilities**

The Supply Chain Manager is accountable for the following essential responsibilities:

* **Demand Planning & Forecasting:** Build and maintain weekly and monthly volume forecasts for all restaurant locations using sales history, product mix, seasonality, holidays, and new restaurant openings.
* **Limited Time Offers & Menu Changes:** Forecast volumes for limited time offers, bundles, and menu changes. Work with suppliers and distributors to plan the ramp up and sell through so launches are fully stocked and leftover product is kept to a minimum.
* **Supply & Inventory Planning:** Track supplier and distributor inventory, flag stockout and overstock risks early, and work with suppliers to adjust production and shipments.
* **Data Analysis & Reporting:** Pull, clean, and analyze data from sales, ordering, distributor, and supplier reports. Build clear reports and trackers that help leadership, Finance, and Operations make decisions.
* **Budget Support:** Support the annual budget and forecast by projecting volumes and spend across food, beverage, and non food categories.
* **Non-Food Procurement:** Lead sourcing and purchasing for non food supplies, smallwares, kitchen equipment, and services such as equipment repair and maintenance, knife sharpening, and cleaning.
* **Negotiation & Contracts:** Run bids and RFPs, compare supplier proposals on total cost, negotiate pricing and terms, and manage contracts through renewal.
* **Equipment Programs:** Plan and purchase equipment for new restaurants, remodels, and replacements in partnership with Operations, Development, and equipment vendors.
* **Vendor Management:** Set up new vendors, track supplier performance on quality, delivery, service, and cost, and resolve supplier issues with restaurants.
* **Purchasing Policies & Compliance:** Help build and enforce purchasing policies, order guides, and approval steps so purchases meet company standards and safety requirements.
* **Cost Savings:** Find, track, and report cost savings, and work with Finance to confirm results.

**Qualifications**

Minimum qualifications include:

* 5+ years of experience in supply chain planning, forecasting, or procurement, ideally in restaurants, food service, or retail.
* Hands on experience forecasting demand and planning supply for a business with many locations.
* Experience buying non food items such as smallwares, equipment, supplies, or services, and negotiating supplier contracts.
* Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, building models). Comfortable working with large sets of data. Power BI, Tableau, or SQL experience is a plus.
* Experience with ordering, ERP, or supply chain planning systems.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain numbers in plain terms to leaders, restaurant teams, and suppliers.
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, or a related field or equivalent experience.

**Leadership Expectations**

The Supply Chain Manager is expected to model collaborative, hands on leadership and reinforce a people-first culture.

* Own planning results and supplier outcomes and independent follow through.
* Build strong working relationships with Operations, Culinary, Marketing, Finance, and suppliers.
* Share information early and clearly, especially when forecasts change or supply is at risk.
* Act with integrity in every supplier relationship and protect Sarku Japan's interests in negotiations.
* Support and mentor analysts and support staff as the team grows.
* Look for ways to simplify how we work and bring new ideas and tools to the team.

* Inventory planning and balancing supply across suppliers and distributors
* Launch planning for limited time offers and menu changes
* Strategic sourcing, bidding, and contract negotiation

**Senior Procurement Analyst**
==============================

East Boston, MA, United States

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Massachusetts Port Authority is **Going Above and Beyond™** for your career. We are a dynamic organization that connects people and businesses to the global community by air, land, and sea. Our employees are essential in moving planes, cargo, and cruise ships safely, efficiently, and sustainably. We are an economic engine, managing real estate assets where people live, work, and play. Together, the properties we own and operate generate $20 billion for the region's economy.

Administration and Finance is dedicated to effectively and responsibly planning, managing, and accounting for Massport's financial resources. We strive to support the Authority's overarching mission by maintaining exemplary standards of excellence, fostering financial sustainability, optimizing resource allocation, and ensuring transparency and accountability in all financial operations. Leveraging meticulous planning, efficient management, and accurate reporting, we employ data analytics and forecasting to drive informed decision-making. Through collaboration with our operating departments, we aim to empower sustained growth and success of the Authority, while contributing to the economic vitality of the region and the fulfillment of our stakeholders' expectations.

**ABOUT YOU**

As a Senior Procurement Analyst, you bring strong judgment, analytical thinking, and a commitment to fairness that helps you navigate complex procurement decisions with clarity and integrity. You communicate openly with stakeholders, build constructive vendor relationships, and foster collaboration across departments. You manage details with precision, adapt quickly to shifting operational needs, and use data, technology, and process improvements to strengthen transparency, efficiency, and overall value in procurement operations.

**What you will do:**

* Leads procurement planning by assessing departmental needs, defining requirements, and maintaining tools and schedules that ensure continuity of goods and services.
* Manages fair and compliant solicitations by developing RFP/RFQ materials, facilitating evaluation processes, and overseeing vendor selection and award decisions.
* Administers contracts and service agreements by coordinating with Legal, processing updates in procurement systems, and monitoring active agreements for timely execution and payments.
* Engages stakeholders and vendors, analyzes procurement data, and recommends improvements that increase efficiency, transparency, and value across procurement operations.

**What you offer:**

* Bachelor's degree in business management, finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* 3-5 years of purchasing experience with demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret RFP responses and perform data analysis.
* Knowledge of e‑procurement practices, with preferred exposure to supplier diversity initiatives, sustainability and NetZero practices, and procurement of EV fleet equipment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience with procurement or accounting systems such as Oracle Fusion or PeopleSoft; professional purchasing certifications are preferred, along with strong verbal and written communication skills.

Collaboration with colleagues at all levels of leadership from all different disciplines, from Aviation to Maritime and beyond. QuEra builds neutral-atom quantum computers. Every machine depends on a large and growing set of laser and optical systems, sourced from specialist suppliers worldwide and deployed across our global sites.

The Technical Buyer will report to the head of Supply Chain, but work hand in hand with the Laser and Optical Systems team to manage QuEra's Optical and Laser Vendor Base. QuEra's Optical and Laser vendor base is the most critical aspect of the supply chain. The role requires competencies in both the technical and commercial sides of the business.

This is a vendor management role with fundamental technical competences in optics. You will work with Optical Systems Team to establish technical specifications with the vendor based on the latest R&D. You will need enough fluency to read a specification, judge a quotation against it, and hold a supplier to what was ordered. You will also need to operate in technical and commercial spaces that are fluid. You must be able to balance technical requirements and deliverable within commercial constraints.

The hardware purchases you will be managing are often state-of-the-art New Products (NPI) for our vendors. Specifications are not always settled when an order is placed; few suppliers can meet them, and nothing is held in stock. Lead times are long, every unit is verified on arrival before it is deployed. Sourcing spans multiple regions with trade compliance and controlled handling. Your skillset should be able to help develop vendor KPI's, keep vendors accountable for non-conforming materials, and find opportunities for new relationships.

**Focus Areas**

* Active components: laser sources, optical amplifiers, modulators, and servo electronics.

* Passive components: optical isolators, nonlinear optical materials, and polarization-maintaining components.

* Custom fiber optics and assemblies, including high-power handling and specialty terminations.

* Integrated laser modules, precision optical assemblies, and associated spares and service parts.

* Routine catalog items continue through the existing purchasing process.

**Responsibilities**

**Sourcing and purchasing**

* Evaluate vendor competencies based on QuEra's R&D specifications and capacity.

* Turn approved specifications into quotable requests; collect and normalize quotations for like-for-like comparison across development cost, lead time, and warranty.

* Understand the vendors ability to both delivery quality product and scale capacity as QuEra moves towards a production environment.

* Develop and Maintain an RFI / RFP / RFQ for new and existing vendors in a dynamic R&D environment.

* Maintain the qualified supplier list by category and track supplier delivery and quality performance

* Act as the intermediary for the Optics and Laser Systems Team and G&A for all high dollar procurements. Ensure that all technical and administrative details have been completed before contracts and purchase orders are executed.

* Work with internal stakeholders on material delivery plan and hold vendors accountable to that plan.

* Coordinate factory acceptance, witness testing, pre-shipment documentation, and incoming quality inspection.

* Carry the supplier correspondence on RMAs, warranty claims, and disputes.

* Have a general understanding of how to implement Supplier Corrective Action Requests.

* Maintain warranty records, flag expiry in advance, and report RMA volume, turnaround, and recurring causes.

**Logistics and compliance**

* Support Custom Packaging Projects for Laser and Optics Systems with the Engineering Team.

* Support the Logistics Team with Customs and Export Compliance as necessary.

**Required Qualifications**

* Degree in a science or engineering field, or equivalent hands-on technical training in technical sales, optical engineering or optics quality management.

* Two or more years working hands-on with lasers or optical systems, in a lab, field service, applications engineering, or technical sales role.

* Two or more years in supplier-facing commercial work in a hardware environment.

* Ability to read a technical specification and hold a supplier accountable to it.

* Experience with ERP or QMS systems.

* Rigorous documentation habits: purchase records, serial numbers, and configuration states recorded as a matter of course.

* Experience with laser and optical specifications: power, wavelength, linewidth, polarization, and fiber interfaces.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Photonics or precision instrumentation background

* Familiarity with procurement under federal funding

* Multi-site or multi-country operations experience

We need someone who **owns it.**

**Position Summary**  
The Buyer/Purchaser is responsible for sourcing and purchasing parts, supplies, and materials needed to support daily operations while maintaining appropriate inventory levels and controlling costs. This position works closely with vendors, parts personnel, service departments, and management to ensure the right products are available at the right price and at the right time.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Review inventory levels, usage history, open orders, and demand to determine purchasing needs.
* Place purchase orders with approved vendors and suppliers.
* Obtain competitive pricing and negotiate discounts, price breaks, freight costs, and other purchasing terms.
* Compare vendor pricing and availability to determine the best overall value.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with vendors and suppliers.
* Monitor purchase orders and follow up on backorders, delayed shipments, and shortages.
* Verify pricing, quantities, part numbers, and shipping information before placing orders.
* Work with vendors to resolve pricing discrepancies, incorrect shipments, damaged products, and returns.
* Maintain accurate purchasing and inventory records.
* Monitor inventory levels to minimize stockouts while avoiding unnecessary overstock.
* Analyze purchasing history and usage trends to identify opportunities for cost savings and improved inventory management.
* Consolidate purchases when practical to reduce freight costs, administrative work, and receiving time.
* Identify opportunities for volume purchasing and bulk discounts.
* Assist with establishing appropriate stocking levels and reorder points.
* Review obsolete, slow-moving, and excess inventory and make recommendations for corrective action.
* Coordinate with the parts counter and service department to ensure customer and repair needs are met.
* Research alternative parts and suppliers when necessary.
* Ensure purchases are made in accordance with company policies and approved vendors.
* Maintain organized documentation of purchase orders, pricing, quotes, and vendor communications.
* Assist with annual and periodic physical inventory counts.
* Stay informed about vendor price changes, product availability, and market conditions.
* Perform other purchasing, inventory, and parts-related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Previous purchasing, parts, inventory, or automotive/heavy-duty experience preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to compare pricing and make cost-effective purchasing decisions.
* Ability to prioritize multiple orders and deadlines.
* Basic computer skills and experience with inventory or purchasing software.
* Ability to read and understand part numbers, product descriptions, and specifications.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently while also working effectively with other departments.

**Key Performance Expectations**

The Buyer/Purchaser should focus on:

* **Cost Control:** Obtain competitive pricing and maximize vendor discounts.
* **Availability:** Maintain adequate inventory to support customers and technicians.
* **Inventory Management:** Reduce excess, obsolete, and slow-moving inventory.
* **Vendor Management:** Build productive relationships and hold vendors accountable for pricing and delivery.
* **Purchasing Efficiency:** Consolidate orders when practical and reduce unnecessary purchasing and receiving activity.
* **Accuracy:** Ensure correct parts, quantities, pricing, and delivery information.
* **Customer Support:** Help ensure parts are available when needed to minimize customer and repair delays.

**Sourcing and Procurement**

* Own day-to-day buying for assigned ingredient categories (proteins, produce, dairy, dry goods, and other raw materials) to meet production schedules without supply interruption.

* Set and maintain sourcing strategy for assigned categories, including single vs. multi-source decisions and supplier qualification pipeline (in partnership with QA and R&D).

* Lead commercial negotiations for assigned categories: price, payment terms, lead times, minimum order quantities, and service levels.
* Build and manage supplier relationships, run regular business reviews, and hold suppliers accountable to cost, quality, and delivery commitments.
* Own contracts and pricing agreements for assigned categories, including renewals and renegotiations ahead of expiration.

* Track commodity markets and cost drivers for assigned categories; forecast cost movement and flag risk to the Senior Purchasing Manager and Finance early.
* Lead cost-down and cost-avoidance initiatives and document realized savings.
* Manage supply risk through buffer strategies, alternate sourcing, and contingency plans for high-risk or single-source items.

**Cross-Functional and Compliance**

* Partner with Planning on demand signals and inventory targets, with QA on supplier and ingredient quality, and with R&D on new ingredient sourcing for product development.
* Maintain accurate purchasing data in the ERP (xTuple), including item, vendor, pricing, and lead-time records for assigned categories.
* Support food safety and regulatory compliance in sourcing decisions (supplier approval status, documentation, FEFO-friendly ordering).

**Leadership and Mentorship**

* Help the Senior Purchasing Manager improve purchasing processes, controls, and reporting.

* Direct experience buying ingredient commodities (proteins, produce, dairy, or dry goods) with real exposure to commodity price volatility.

* Strong working knowledge of MRP and ERP systems and purchasing workflows.
* Solid Excel skills (analysis, cost comparisons, supplier scorecards).
* Understanding of food safety and quality basics in a manufacturing setting (GMPs, supplier approval, lot and shelf-life considerations).
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work across Operations, Planning, QA, R&D, and Finance.

* Experience with xTuple or a comparable manufacturing ERP.

**A Snapshot of Your Day**

As a PM/Sourcing Manager for Exhaust Systems, you will work within international proposal and execution teams to manage sourcing activities, supplier performance, and commercial responsibilities for exhaust systems and related equipment. You will collaborate closely with Project Management, Engineering, Logistics, and suppliers to ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality and safety requirements. Your day will include evaluating customer specifications, developing sourcing strategies, leading supplier negotiations, and supporting project execution from proposal through completion.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Lead sourcing and commercial activities for Exhaust Systems projects during proposal and execution phases.
* Develop and implement sourcing strategies that support cost, quality, delivery, and business objectives.
* Evaluate customer and project requirements and prepare commercial specifications and inquiry packages.
* Manage supplier selection, bid evaluations, contract negotiations, and contract execution activities.
* Monitor supplier performance to ensure compliance with project schedules, quality standards, and cost commitments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Project Management, Logistics, and Site Operations to deliver successful project outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, supplier management, project management, or contract management within exhaust systems, power generation, EPC projects, industrial equipment, or related industries.
* Experience negotiating commercial agreements and managing supplier and contractor performance throughout project lifecycles.
* Strong knowledge of sourcing, procurement, and project execution processes with the ability to manage competing priorities in a global environment.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.

Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. Siemens Energy employees with current visa sponsorship may be eligible for internal transfers.

**About the Team**

**Gas Services**

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

-----------------------------

Evolve Transporters is a high-end custom fabrication company with locations in the greater Indianapolis, Indiana and Cleveland, Ohio areas. We partner with some of the largest motorsports teams and brands in the world, designing and fabricating premium race transporters and mobile workspaces. Our success is built on craftsmanship, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction.

**About Martin Inc.**

Founded in 1934 and headquartered in Florence, AL, Martin offers a wide variety of products and services in Industrial, Safety, Integrated Supply and Fastening – all uniquely designed to help companies operate better. Martin is a member of Affiliated Distributors, the Industrial Supply Association, National Association of Wholesalers, the National Fasteners Distributor Association, and the Global Sourcing Alliance. For more information, visit www.martinsupply.com.

**Summary:**

The Buyer is responsible for purchasing MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) materials, equipment, supplies, and services, following established purchasing regulations and procedures. They review and analyze purchase requisitions, identify and develop reliable sources of supplies, prepare bid specifications, request bids, evaluate quotations, and act as a liaison between user departments and vendors. Additionally, the Buyer performs storeroom duties, including receiving materials, stocking inventory, cycle counting, point-of-use replenishment, and related tasks.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review and analyze departmental purchase requisitions, ensuring completeness and accuracy of information.
* Contact departments or initiators to clarify or complete requisition details.
* Determine appropriate method for processing requisitions based on factors such as dollar amount, timeliness, existing contracts, and competitive bidding.
* Identify and select vendors based on criteria like price, quantity, quality, and delivery date, and place orders accordingly.
* Possess knowledge of purchasing practices, procedures, materials, products, and the commodity market within the area of specialization.
* Prepare and analyze complex technical specifications and bids.
* Create and review purchase orders.
* Resolve accounts payable issues and handle purchasing data input and retrieval.
* Assist internal and external customers by addressing inquiries both verbally and in writing.
* Provide customer service within the storeroom, including pulling orders based on customer needs.

### **The Role**

Your next opportunity shouldn’t depend on your last job title but on your skills.

At AMS, we focus on skills, potential, and the ability to grow. We are looking for a Talent Sourcing Specialist who brings strong capability in identify, engage, and assess high-caliber talent while partnering closely with Recruiters and hiring managers to build robust talent pipelines for Wealth Management Club Concierge team and is motivated to contribute to real, measurable results.

### **Key Accountabilities**

**Strategic Talent Sourcing**

* Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to identify and attract top talent across a variety of channels.
* Leverage LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, networking, referrals, talent communities, and market research to build diverse talent pipelines.
* Conduct market mapping and competitor research to identify potential candidate pools and hiring trends.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

**Candidate Assessment & Talent Discovery**

* Conduct detailed screening conversations to evaluate candidate experience, potential, motivations, and long-term career goals.
* Look beyond resumes and job titles to identify transferable skills and high-potential talent.
* Uncover information that may not be immediately apparent through traditional screening methods.
* Assess candidate fit against technical requirements, business needs, and organizational culture.
* Identify strong candidates who may otherwise be overlooked by conventional recruiting methods.

**Candidate Engagement & Coaching**

* Engage passive candidates and build meaningful relationships throughout the hiring process.
* Educate and coach candidates on opportunities, market trends, and hiring processes.
* Prepare candidates for interviews and guide them through each stage of the recruitment journey.

**Partnership & Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Recruiters to understand hiring needs, target profiles, and market challenges.
* Provide talent market insights and recommendations to support recruitment strategies.
* Collaborate with recruitment teams to ensure quality candidate delivery and strong hiring outcomes.

**Pipeline & Process Management**

* Maintain accurate pipeline activity and candidate records within ATS and CRM systems.
* Stay on top of candidate engagement, follow-ups, and recruitment timelines.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and sourcing best practices.

### **Skills & Requirements**

**Must Have:**

* 2-5 years of talent sourcing, recruiting, or talent acquisition experience.
* Proven ability to identify and engage passive candidates.
* Strong candidate assessment and screening capabilities.
* Experience building talent pipelines for specialized, niche, or hard-to-fill roles.
* Ability to uncover candidate motivations, career aspirations, and potential concerns through effective questioning.
* Strong relationship-building and communication skills.
* Ability to identify transferable skills and evaluate potential beyond a candidate's resume.
* Strong organizational and follow-up skills with the ability to manage multiple searches simultaneously.
* Experience working collaboratively with Recruiters and hiring managers.
* Detail-oriented with a proactive and solutions-focused mindset.

**Nice-to-Have :**

* Experience sourcing within Financial Services sector.
* Experience supporting highly specialized or client-facing business functions.

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite of programs

* Identify and source prospective scientific, clinical, and technical reviewers aligned to current and anticipated peer review requirements.

* Review professional credentials, research backgrounds, publications, clinical expertise, methodologies, and other available information to identify potentially qualified candidates.
* Conduct professional outreach to prospective reviewers and communicate review opportunities, participation requirements, timelines, and expectations.
* Build and maintain pipelines of prospective and returning reviewers across biomedical disciplines and specialty areas.
* Support proactive pipeline development for anticipated program and mechanism needs rather than waiting until reviewer recruitment begins.
* Support rapid identification of replacement reviewers when selected reviewers become unavailable or additional expertise is required.
* Maintain accurate sourcing, outreach, availability, expertise, and recruitment-status information in applicable systems.
* Monitor recruitment progress and identify difficult-to-source specialties, emerging gaps, and reviewer-supply risks.
* Expand reviewer pools by identifying qualified new and underutilized experts.
* Support relationships with scientific and professional societies, academic and research institutions, clinical organizations, and other sources of qualified experts.
* Coordinate closely with Scientific Review Officers (SROs) and Scientific Review Managers (SRMs) to understand program-, panel-, mechanism-, and application-specific expertise requirements.
* Provide candidate information to SROs and scientific review leadership to support reviewer evaluation and selection.

Every data center Hut 8 builds depends on a particular list of materials that are expensive, commodity driven, and critical to get on time. This Sourcing Manager owns those categories.

* Own sourcing strategies for specialty construction materials including MV and LV cables, conduit, grounding systems, fiber, , and electrical distribution equipment across the full site supply chain.

-----------------------------

* Responsible for strategy input and implementation for complex and strategic categories
* Delivers key category performance indicators, including: savings, supplier rationalization, low-cost region sourcing, risk management, spend under agreement, joint innovation, supplier performance, etc
* Develops multi year global sourcing strategies focused on identifying suppliers that meet key business category management goals

------------------------------

* Acts as a coach/mentor to colleagues on category strategy process

* Bachelor’s degree in Business or technical field or equivalent combination of experience and education. Master’s Degree is preferred
* Minimum of 10 years procurement/sourcing experience in mid to large multinational companies, with strong category/business engagement experience
* MRO experience is a must
* Experience working in highly regulated industries
* Experience in a continuous improvement environment with a track record of achieving significant year over year results
* Demonstrated consultative, collaborative and influencing style in performing sourcing activities
* Experience in life sciences, medical devices, or pharmaceutical industries is preferred

This position will be expected to deliver value and competitive advantage to the business as measured by project execution, cost optimization, value improvement, innovation, risk mitigation, and supplier performance.

The Strategic Sourcing Manager will drive strategy development, cost management and reduction targets, and coordinate sourcing activities to support project initiatives. This role will work with cross-functional teams to create an efficient and innovative partnership across all functions and levels of the organization. This position is responsible for approximately $150M–$200M in construction-related spend across materials and trade partners, and reports to the Director of Purchasing.

* Understand and track key input cost drivers and market factors for assigned categories, provide countermeasure concepts, forecasting, and maintain cost models and should-cost assumptions adapted to construction materials and services
* Provide category knowledge and market expertise for assigned spend and continuously learn construction materials, subcontracting practices, and industry best practices that deliver value to Roers Companies

Sourcing Process

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for an exceptional Sourcing Manager to own the machine tools that will produce the highest cost content in our product.  
  
Precision machining is the established process for our actuator components and gears, and the equipment you select sets cycle time, machine count and cost per part at volume. Multi axis machining centers, turning, grinding, gear cutting and finishing, EDM and metrology, along with the automation and work holding around them. You will commit long lead equipment ahead of production need and work directly with process engineering on capability requirements at tolerances and hardness levels that leave very little margin.  
  
This is a builder role in a zero to one manufacturing environment. There is no incumbent equipment base and no established supplier list. You will build both, and what you specify will still be running when we are producing at a rate no program has reached.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Machining Equipment Sourcing: Own end-to-end capital equipment sourcing, including supplier identification, market analysis, RFQ/RFP execution, total cost of ownership modeling, and award decisions across multi-axis CNC machining centers, turning centers, grinding, gear cutting and finishing, EDM, deburring and cleaning, metrology, and the automation and work-holding supporting them. Develop and implement sourcing approaches that optimize cost efficiency while advancing technical capabilities. Build machine-rate and cycle-time models that translate equipment selection into cost per part at volume.
* Contract Negotiations: Lead complex negotiations with OEMs, equipment manufacturers, integrators and service providers, structuring commercial agreements covering pricing, payment terms, warranties, acceptance criteria, run-at-rate and capability protocols, SLAs, and long-lead-time components, and managing the full contract lifecycle including amendments, renewals, and dispute resolution.
* Long-Lead Commitment and Schedule Risk: Own the machining equipment commitment calendar against factory move-in and start-of-production dates. Flag items where lead time exceeds available schedule and drive mitigation through slot reservations, phased releases or alternate suppliers.
* Process and Tooling Partnership: Work with Manufacturing and Process Engineering on machine capability requirements, including tolerance, concentricity, surface finish and hardness. Support cutting tool, fixture and work-holding strategy as part of total cost.
* Procurement Frameworks: Develop sourcing frameworks, standard operating procedures, and operating mechanisms that scale with the organization, supporting and mentoring sourcing managers and buyers through technical guidance.
* Supplier Performance Management: Establish and manage supplier performance programs, including scorecards, SLAs, and regular business reviews. Identify and mitigate supply chain risks through dual-sourcing strategies, should-cost models, and contingency planning. Assess supplier capability to build, install and commission at rate, not only to quote.
* Budget Management: Manage capital budgets with cost controls, variance tracking, and change management governance. Support material planning, inventory strategy, and spare parts availability. Drive cost optimization initiatives with demonstrated results.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Align equipment procurement timelines with site milestones and schedules in close partnership with cross-functional teams across the organization. Serve as a procurement subject matter expert in cross-functional planning forums. Influence leadership on strategic direction and investment decisions related to the supply chain.

  
About the team  
Amazon is building the next generation of robotics technology, and this role is key to our vision. Our Supply Chain team is responsible for standing up and scaling the procurement, sourcing, and supplier management functions. We are a small, high-impact team solving complex problems at the intersection of technology and production, and we are looking for builders who want to shape something from the ground up.

------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
* 6+ years of experience in supply chain management, strategic sourcing, or procurement in manufacturing, industrial automation, or similar technical environment
* Experience managing capital equipment procurement programs and vendor portfolios for complex environments, including equipment, automation, and tooling
* Experience leading contract negotiations with OEMs, equipment manufacturers, or construction contractors for agreements of significant value
* Experience developing sourcing strategies, procurement frameworks, or standard operating procedures
* Experience sourcing machine tools, precision metalworking equipment or related production automation

About Wood-Mizer

Wood-Mizer is the world's largest manufacturer of portable sawmills, with more than 100,000 mills sold in over 100 countries. We're 100% employee-owned, so every team member has a stake in our success, and we put our people and customers at the center of everything we do.

Position Summary

The Global Sourcing Specialist develops and executes sourcing strategies that expand Wood-Mizer's global supply base into lower-cost producing countries, including China, India, greater Asia Pacific, Latin America, and Eastern Europe. The role is accountable for cost reduction and cost avoidance across assigned commodities, qualifying new suppliers, and leading cross-functional cost optimization projects with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Finance. This work turns market and commodity trends into pricing forecasts and negotiation strategies that lower product cost and protect supply continuity. This hybrid role travels up to 40%, domestically and internationally. It has no direct reports at the start, with the potential to build a sourcing team over time.

Essential Functions

Develops and executes strategic sourcing plans that expand the supply base into China, India, Asia Pacific, Latin America, and other qualified lower-cost countries.  
Identifies, evaluates, and qualifies new suppliers through capability assessments, on-site audits, and risk evaluations before onboarding.  
Manages supplier relationships for assigned commodities through performance scorecards, business reviews, and continuous improvement plans, and partners with Quality on supplier corrective actions and periodic audits.  
Leads cost reduction and cost avoidance initiatives, building should-cost and total-cost-of-ownership (TCO) models and tracking savings in Infor Syteline, Wrike, and Qlik to meet annual savings targets.  
Monitors global market trends, commodity indexes, currency exposure, and supply risk, and develops forecasts and pricing-impact projections for leadership.  
Negotiates, drafts, and manages supplier contracts through their lifecycle to secure favorable terms, supply continuity, and compliance with corporate policy.  
Leads sourcing for new product development, engineering changes, and product cost-outs in close collaboration with Engineering and Manufacturing.  
Develops dual-sourcing and supply risk mitigation plans for critical components.  
Plans and procures material for assigned commodities, balancing cost, lead time, inventory, and supply risk.  
Ensures sourcing decisions and supplier agreements comply with trade regulations (tariffs, duties, Incoterms), corporate compliance requirements, and ethical sourcing standards.  
Follows all Wood-Mizer safety, quality, and company policies and procedures.  
Performs other duties as assigned.

Required

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience  
4+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management  
Hands-on international sourcing and supplier relationship management experience, with a focus on China, Asia Pacific, Latin America, India, and other lower-cost regions  
Proven record of leading cost reduction and cost avoidance initiatives with measurable, documented savings  
Experience leading supplier identification, qualification, and onboarding in a manufacturing environment  
Strong contract negotiation, drafting, and vendor management skills  
Working knowledge of Incoterms, import/export compliance, tariffs, and international logistics  
Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems (Infor Syteline or comparable) and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)  
Strong analytical skills, including building cost models and turning commodity and market data into actionable forecasts  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership  
Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 40%

Preferred

CPSM, CPIM, CSCP, or C.P.M. certification  
Experience sourcing mechanical, metal fabrication, casting, electronics, or engineered components in a manufacturing or industrial equipment environment  
Ability to read engineering drawings, product prints, and specifications to evaluate supplier capability, support quoting, and identify cost-reduction opportunities  
Working knowledge of manufacturing processes such as machining, fabrication, casting, welding, and sheet metal  
Familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma and continuous improvement tools  
Experience with Wrike, Qlik, or similar project management and business intelligence platforms  
Mandarin, Spanish, or Portuguese language skills

Fervo Energy is developing and operating next-generation geothermal assets that deliver reliable, 24/7 carbon-free electricity. As Fervo commissions new facilities and expands its operating portfolio, timely and disciplined operational procurement will be essential to maintaining safe, reliable, and cost-effective plant performance.

The Senior Procurement Specialist, Operations is responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and expediting spare parts, consumables, equipment, and services supporting commissioning, maintenance, and plant operations. This role helps protect plant availability while improving cost competitiveness, supplier performance, procurement compliance, and warranty recovery.

The position manages the purchase order lifecycle within Fervo's ERP system and collaborates closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Warehouse, Finance, Accounts Payable, and suppliers. Based in Utah, the role will be located in Milford (preferred) or Salt Lake City to provide close operational support, strengthen local and regional supplier intelligence, and respond quickly to field requirements.

Requirements:

***Responsibilities***

* Operational procurement. Source and procure MRO materials, critical spare parts, consumables, chemicals, equipment, repair services, and other operational requirements.
* Requirements review. Review purchase requisitions and technical requirements for completeness, coordinating with Commissioning, Operations and Production to confirm specifications and approve proposed alternatives or cross references.
* Purchase order management. Manage the complete purchase order lifecycle, including quotation, commercial evaluation, negotiation, PO issuance, expediting, receipt, invoice resolution, and closeout within the ERP system.
* Expediting and readiness. Monitor open orders, supplier commitments, and critical delivery dates; proactively communicate delays, risks, and mitigation actions supporting Cape Station commissioning, outages, and routine operations.
* Supplier and buying-channel optimization. Develop qualified local and regional suppliers, preferred-supplier arrangements, catalogs, and blanket purchase orders to improve competition and reduce procurement-card purchasing.
* Pricing and market intelligence. Maintain pricing and purchasing data, benchmark market conditions, monitor key cost drivers, and identify savings, standardization, and supplier-consolidation opportunities.
* Warranty process optimization. Review warranty coverage before replacement purchases and coordinate notifications, repairs, replacements, credits, recoveries, and escalation of disputed or delayed claims.
* Supplier performance. Monitor supplier quality, cost, delivery, responsiveness, and warranty support; coordinate corrective actions and continuous improvement.
* KPI reporting and analysis. Prepare and analyze metrics covering PO cycle time, competitive-bid compliance, open orders, supplier on-time delivery, emergency purchases, savings, cost avoidance, and warranty recovery; use findings to identify risks and improve processes.

***Qualifications***

*Required*

* Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Five or more years of purchasing, procurement, materials management, or supply chain experience in energy, power generation, manufacturing, oil and gas, or a similar industrial environment.
* Experience procuring MRO materials, spare parts, industrial equipment, consumables, repair services, and field services.
* Experience managing purchase requisitions, purchase orders, expediting, supplier performance, and invoice or receiving discrepancies.
* Proficiency with ERP or procurement systems such as SAP or Oracle, along with strong Excel, KPI reporting, and analytical skills.
* Strong commercial judgment, negotiation, organization, communication, and problem-solving capabilities, including the ability to manage urgent requirements while maintaining procurement controls.

*Preferred*

* Experience supporting geothermal, power generation, renewable energy, process plant, or other asset-intensive operations.
* Familiarity with inventory management, warehouse, maintenance management, and material master data processes.
* Experience coordinating equipment warranty claims, supplier corrective actions, repairs, replacements, and credits.
* Familiarity with industrial part specifications, cross-references, obsolescence risks, market benchmarking, Incoterms, and freight coordination.

***Success in the Role***

Success means Fervo's operational teams receive the materials, services, and supplier support they need when required while improving purchasing responsiveness, plant availability, reliable operations, cost competitiveness, warranty recovery, supplier performance, data quality, and procurement compliance.

Develop and execute Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Quotes (RFQs) and/or Requests for Information (RFIs) based on identified business needs, market conditions and corpoate standards. Facilitate analysis, evaluation and scoring of vendor proposals against criteria established and agreed on by the team. Conduct multiple rounds of bids and coordinate activities such as vendor demonstrations, reference calls and on-site visits to short-list vendors. Lead contract negotiations in conjunction with the Project Team and Legal to ensure we obtain the most competitive pricing and favorable terms possible. Prepare sufficient documentation to inform Executive Sponsor and senior managers of recommendations and results of the sourcing initiative, including any achieved savings, customer implications and impacts to business operations. Guide business and support units through the Third-Party Risk Management Program in conjunction with the Third-Party Risk Management team to ensure selected vendors are properly risk tiered, vetted and approved before executing a contract. Research and analyze procurement trend data at the Bank and recommend savings opportunities to associated business lines ad support functions .Understand and adhere to the Company's risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company's Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management. Promote an environment that supports diversity and reflects the Bank brand. Maintain internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable. Complete other related duties as assigned.

Amazon is seeking a motivated, data-driven Sr. Category Manager to support Americas data center expansion and infrastructure development within the Energy Infrastructure and Projects portfolio. * Manage competing priorities across a dynamic portfolio, consistently delivering on-time results within committed timeframes and budget parameters.

* Industry Experience — Background in Oil & Gas, Utility, or Energy sectors strongly preferred.

description:
Description:

If you like a variety of work in your day, this job is perfect for you! Local candidates only.

The **Procurement Specialist / Executive Administrator & Office Administrator** is a hybrid role responsible for supporting the Company's day-to-day procurement activities while also providing executive administrative and office management support.

Approximately **80% of the role is focused on transactional procurement activities**, including supplier onboarding and administration, purchase order processing, procurement system maintenance, sourcing support, invoice and contract administration. The position works closely with the Procurement Manager and internal stakeholders to help ensure procurement transactions are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established policies and procedures.

The remaining **20% of the role provides Executive Administrator and Office Manager support**, including calendar and meeting coordination, travel arrangements, office administration, document management, and other administrative activities necessary to support effective business operations.

Requirements:

**Procurement Specialist - Approximately 80%**

* Manage day-to-day purchase requisition and purchase order activities, including creating, processing, tracking, updating and closing purchase orders.
* Review purchase requisitions for completeness, appropriate coding, supporting documentation, and required approvals.
* Monitor open purchase orders and follow up with internal stakeholders and suppliers to address outstanding items.
* Assist with maintaining the purchase order approval hierarchy and established procurement workflows.
* Support the resolution of purchase order, receipt, and invoice discrepancies in coordination with Finance and internal stakeholders.
* Help ensure purchases are made through approved suppliers and established procurement channels.
* Support controls relating to online ordering and non-PO purchases.

**Supplier Administration & Onboarding**

* Coordinate new supplier onboarding
* Maintain accurate supplier information, including purchasing details, payment terms, contacts, and supporting documentation.
* Assist in maintaining preferred supplier lists and procurement catalogs.
* Monitor supplier documentation and follow up on outstanding or expired information as required.
* Support supplier performance tracking, including delivery performance, service issues, and supplier error rates.
* Maintain organized electronic supplier and procurement records.

**Sourcing & Tender Support**

* Assist the Procurement Manager with day-to-day sourcing activities and competitive bidding processes.
* Identify potential suppliers and obtain quotations for goods and services.
* Prepare and issue routine RFQs and support RFP activities as assigned.
* Coordinate bidder communications, proposal receipt, and procurement documentation.
* Prepare commercial bid comparisons and pricing summaries for review.
* Assist with scheduling supplier meetings, clarification sessions, and evaluations.
* Maintain sourcing documentation to support procurement governance and audit requirements.

**Spend Tracking, Reporting & Procurement Support**

* Prepare routine procurement reports, including purchase order activity, supplier spend and outstanding order
* Assist with monitoring supplier and procurement KPIs.
* Identify recurring transactional issues and recommend opportunities to improve procurement processes and controls.
* Assist with procurement-related training and guidance for internal users.
* Support inventory-related procurement activities and processes, where applicable.

**Executive Administrator / Office Manager - Approximately 20%**

* Provide administrative support to designated senior leadership, including calendar management and meeting coordination.
* Schedule internal and external meetings and coordinate meeting logistics.
* Coordinate business travel arrangements and itineraries, as required.
* Assist with meeting preparation
* Handle business information and correspondence with appropriate confidentiality and discretion.
* Provide general administrative support to leadership as business needs require.

**Office Management**

* Coordinate routine office administrative activities to support an organized and professional workplace.
* Manage office supplies and coordinate replenishment while following established procurement procedures.
* Serve as a point of contact for routine office-related supplier and service matters.
* Coordinate office maintenance and service requests with appropriate internal teams and external providers.
* Assist with onsite meetings, visitors, and other office logistics when required.
* Maintain appropriate office files, records, and administrative documentation.
* Help identify opportunities to improve office administration, organization, and efficiency.
* Perform other reasonable administrative duties necessary to support efficient office operations.
