**Job Description:**

Ryan Companies US, Inc. is seeking a proactive, highly motivated, and results-driven **Sr. Sourcing Specialist** to join our Talent Acquisition team. In this critical role, you will champion top-of-funnel candidate identification, engagement, and talent pipeline strategies across our fully integrated platform—spanning Construction, Real Estate Development, and Architecture & Engineering (A+E). As our dedicated sourcing partner, you will identify, engage, and nurture relationships with high-caliber passive talent for Construction, Real Estate Development, and Architecture & Engineering (A+E). Core searches include Field Operations (Superintendents, Field Coordinators, Safety Managers), Project Management (Project Managers, Project Executives, Estimators), and Design/Engineering professionals (Architects, Structural Engineers, MEP Coordinators). Working in close partnership with Full-Cycle Recruiters and Construction/A+E Leadership, you will serve as Ryan’s brand ambassador in the market, converting passive industry talent into valued team members.

**To be successful in this role you will have:**

  
  

Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Development

* **Proactive Talent Identification:** Mine social media, professional networking platforms, trade associations, and talent databases (e.g., LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Google X-Ray, Handshake) to uncover top passive talent in commercial construction and design disciplines.
* **Advanced Sourcing Methodologies:** Develop and execute sophisticated Boolean search strings, market-mapping techniques, and competitive talent intelligence to locate niche, hard-to-find technical and operational talent.
* **Talent Communities & CRM Management:** Build, categorize, and actively nurture talent pools within our CRM and ATS (Workday) to support both active immediate hiring needs and strategic future project demands.
* **Market Intelligence & Research:** Monitor industry hiring trends, competitor organizational structures, regional labor market conditions, and compensation benchmarks across our operating regions.

Candidate Engagement & Outreach

* **Personalized Outreach Campaigns:** Craft persuasive, compelling candidate outreach communications that articulate Ryan’s distinct company culture, integrated project delivery model, and value proposition.
* **Initial Screening & Qualification:** Conduct initial discovery calls and phone screenings to assess candidate interest, technical background, career aspirations, and cultural alignment.
* **Relationship Nurturing:** Establish warm relationships with prospective candidates early, maintaining regular touchpoints over months and years to ensure Ryan remains top-of-mind when they are ready to explore new opportunities.
* **Candidate Experience:** Ensure every prospect receives an exceptional, transparent, and respectful experience representing Ryan Companies from the very first interaction.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Workflow Integration

* **Strategic Partnership with TA & Leadership:** Partner closely with Talent Acquisition Managers, Recruiters, and regional Construction/A+E Leaders to calibrate job profiles, review pipeline metrics, and adjust sourcing strategies in real time.
* **Referral Generation:** Proactively engage internal construction teams, project sites, and design studios to source employee referrals and maximize organic talent networks.
* **Handoff Coordination:** Coordinate seamless introductions and interview scheduling between qualified prospects, assigned recruiters, and hiring managers to sustain momentum throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* **Data Integrity & Reporting:** Maintain meticulous candidate tracking records in Workday/CRM, delivering regular updates on sourcing volume, conversion rates, and pipeline health.

**To be successful in this role you will have:**

  
  

* **Experience:** Minimum of 6+ years of dedicated talent sourcing or full-cycle recruiting experience.
* **Industry Focus:** Proven experience identifying and engaging talent within Commercial Construction, Real Estate Development, or Architecture and Engineering (A+E).
* **Technical Sourcing Capabilities:** Demonstrated mastery of LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search logic, candidate relationship management systems (CRM), and enterprise Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g., Workday).
* **Construction Knowledge:** Working understanding of commercial construction lifecycles, project delivery methods (Design-Build, CM at Risk, General Contracting), and key operational roles (Superintendent, Project Manager, Estimator, Architect, MEP Engineer).
* **Communication Skills:** Outstanding verbal and written communication abilities with demonstrated success in crafting customized, high-conversion candidate outreach.
* **Drive & Organization:** Self-starter mindset with strong organizational habits, capable of prioritizing multiple urgent searches across diverse geographic regions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business A

Strategic Sourcing and Commodity Procurement

---------------

Are you a Strategic Sourcing superstar looking to make a big impact?  
  
As Amazon rapidly becomes the world's largest consumer of corporate services, our Global Corporate Procurement team is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Specialist to join our team.  
  
Strategic Sourcing Specialists, working under the general direction of more senior team members, manage strategic sourcing engagements as a central team supporting a wide range of Amazon and subsidiary business units.  
  
In this pivotal role, you'll design innovative sourcing strategies and lead sourcing engagements across a wide range of business units. Your mission? Improve performance, optimize efficiency, ensure top-notch quality, and enable new initiatives to launch and scale with lightning speed.  
  
Demonstrating a passionate commitment to procurement excellence, you will flawlessly handle and execute sourcing initiatives, communicating efficiently and effectively with stakeholders across various business units. Adept at juggling multiple priorities, you will thrive in the fast-paced, dynamic environment, contributing to both short-term tactical and long-term strategic efforts.  
  
Does this sound like your next great challenge? If you're passionate about finding the right products, goods and services at the right time from the right suppliers, we want to hear from you.  
  
Come join our fast-paced, innovative team and help Amazon make history in Corporate Procurement.  
Apply today!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Establishing strong relationships with internal business partners; building a robust understanding of strategic business direction, requirements and priorities across assigned suppliers and/or spend categories.
* Supporting execution of sourcing events across all indirect spend categories
* Delivering savings and increased spend under management by driving adoption of a automated self-service sourcing technology application
* Supporting enhancements and the product development roadmap of the self-service sourcing application based upon purchasing history and stakeholder sourcing requirements
* Managing the fundamentals of sourcing and supplier engagement activities including RFx, spend pattern analysis, contract analysis, bid evaluation, negotiations, and supplier consolidation.
* Working with business and finance leaders to identify and drive savings and controllership improvements, focusing on total cost of ownership.
* Providing guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement strategies; maintaining procurement ethics in accordance with Amazon’s global policies.

------------------------

* 3+ years of supply chain management, planning, strategic sourcing, commodity management or program management experience

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret purchasing data and identify savings opportunities

description:
**WHY VEIR?**

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, VEIR is a U.S.-based designer and manufacturer of category-defining superconducting power delivery systems built for the extreme energy demands of the AI era. By commercializing next-generation superconducting technology into deployable, real-world systems, VEIR delivers ~10× higher power density than conventional options, enabling "speed-to-power" where incremental optimization falls short. VEIR's initial focus is AI data centers behind the meter, with solutions engineered for repeatable deployment through reference designs and integrated controls, designed to incorporate learnings as deployments scale.

**The Role**

VEIR is seeking a Commodity Manager to own sourcing and supplier management for the Liquid Nitrogen (LIN) Cooling System — a technically demanding, cryogenics-driven subsystem with long-lead, often sole-sourced components that are critical to product reliability.

This person will run the sourcing program for the cooling system, focused on reducing long lead times through multi-sourcing strategy, supplier development, and supplier agreements. As part of VEIR's NPI stage-gate process, this role owns key sourcing deliverables at each phase — candidate identification, RFI/RFQ development with Engineering, supplier audits, PPAP quality support, and process validation — to move cooling system suppliers from qualification through production readiness. This role requires close collaboration with Engineering and Quality on supplier qualification — including site audits — as well as cross-functional coordination across Product, Commercial, Project, Finance, Procurement, and Logistics teams.

**In the first 3 months you'll**

* Learn VEIR's LIN cooling system architecture, current supplier base, and known lead time/capacity constraints.
* Build relationships with key cooling system suppliers, including pump, skid, and vessel fabricators.
* Support ongoing supplier development activities aimed at reducing long lead times on critical components, working toward 4–5 commercially viable candidates per critical component.
* Partner with Engineering to support internal RFI development and preliminary RFQs against early (Ph2/Ph3) BOM, drawing, and specification releases.
* Partner with Procurement on AVL status and onboarding documentation for cooling system suppliers.
* Join Engineering and Quality on at least one supplier site visit or technical/quality capability audit to build first-hand supplier knowledge.

**In the first 6 months you'll**

* Own the sourcing strategy and supplier base for the LIN Cooling System commodity, including pumps, skids, vessels, and related cryogenic components.
* Own development of detailed production RFQs following design release, incorporating manufacturing requirements, critical-to-quality (CTQ) specs, and PPAP/qualification requirements, in partnership with Engineering.
* Support Engineering during sample builds and DFM iteration with candidate suppliers, ensuring feedback closes into the design ahead of design lock.
* Partner with Quality to support supplier PPAP submissions (Part Submission Warrant, dimensional reports, process capability, material certifications) as part of production qualification.
* Support process validation / run-at-rate studies to confirm supplier capacity and process capability against forecast.
* Drive multi-sourcing strategy and supplier capacity development to reduce long lead times on critical components, and support second-source qualification for the highest-risk items.
* Identify, evaluate, and qualify fabricators or contract manufacturers to support cooling system components as VEIR scales.
* Lead negotiation of supplier agreements, pricing structures, and commercial terms in partnership with Procurement and Finance.
* Build supplier scorecards and support periodic business reviews as suppliers move into ramp.
* Partner with Logistics on packaging and shipping plans, including any special handling requirements for cooling system components.
* Build a multi-year sourcing roadmap for the LIN Cooling System commodity in support of VEIR's scale-up plans.

**To be successful in this role**

**You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in supply chain, commodity management, or strategic sourcing, ideally within a technical or cryogenics-adjacent environment.
* A technical engineering background; experience in cryogenics preferred.
* Experience setting up or managing fabricators or contract manufacturers preferred.
* Experience developing RFIs and RFQs in partnership with engineering teams, from prototype-level through production-intent sourcing.
* Familiarity with NPI stage-gate processes and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) is strongly preferred.

Under general supervision, the Senior Sourcing Manager leads complex, high-impact competitive sourcing activities for Harris County by planning and executing solicitations from intake through award recommendation. This position supports county-wide operations serving approximately 5 million residents, 20,000 employees in 80 departments, and roughly $5.5B in annual expenditures.

  
  

The role develops sourcing strategy, scopes/specifications, evaluation criteria, and solicitation documents; manages bidder communications, timelines, and sensitive procurements; conducts market research and cost/price analysis; and leads evaluation and negotiation support to achieve best-value outcomes.

  
  

The Senior Sourcing Manager provides guidance and direction to sourcing staff and ensures sourcing actions remain compliant and defensible by applying County policies and applicable procurement requirements, including Texas Local Government Code Chapter 262 and applicable federal requirements when federal funds apply.

  
  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Leads complex intake and procurement planning with departments by defining requirements, scope, evaluation methodology, and timelines, selecting the legally appropriate procurement method under Texas Local Government Code Chapter 262 and applicable County policy, and providing technical guidance to sourcing staff.
* Develops and executes complex competitive solicitations (RFP, CSP, RFSQ, CMAR, and other authorized methods), including specifications/scopes, evaluation criteria, contractual requirements, required postings/advertisements, addenda control, vendor communications, and resolution of sensitive issues.
* Ensures personal, professional services and specialized procurements follow applicable authorities, including Texas Government Code §2254 where applicable, and leads compliant documentation for interlocal/cooperative contracting (including authorities such as Chapter 791/Chapter 271 when applicable) and sole source/exception pathways.
* Directs receipt, review, and evaluation of submissions, including responsiveness checks, evaluation facilitation, clarifications, negotiation support as applicable, and preparation of defensible award recommendations, approvals, and Commissioners Court materials when required.
* Performs advanced market research and cost/price analysis to support best-value determinations and total cost of ownership decisions; documents sourcing rationale, assumptions, and risk considerations to maintain audit-ready procurement files.
* Coordinates with Purchasing leadership, Legal, Auditor, Risk Management and DEEO as applicable to manage compliance risk, conflicts of interest, protests and challenges, vendor responsibility issues, and corrective actions; drives continuous improvement of sourcing templates, controls, and workflows and mentors staff on standards.
* Ensure full compliance with: Texas Local Government Code Chapter 262, Texas Government Code Chapter 2269 (Construction), 2 C.F.R. 200 (federal awards), as amended, GLO CDBG-DR/CDBG-MIT requirements.

* Score suppliers on on-time delivery and incoming quality, review them quarterly with the Quality Manager, and replace any that keep missing after corrective action.

**Purchase Orders and Material Planning**

* Turn the production schedule, base vehicle arrival dates, and the released bill of material into a rolling purchasing forecast, and buy in release blocks so material lands ahead of each block without tying up cash in excess stock.

Position Overview

Our client, a well-established and growing manufacturing company, is seeking an experienced Senior Buyer to join their purchasing and supply chain team. The Senior Buyer will be responsible for managing the procurement of materials, components, and services necessary to support manufacturing operations while maintaining cost, quality, delivery, and inventory objectives.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in manufacturing purchasing, excellent supplier management and negotiation skills, and hands-on experience working within an ERP system. This position requires someone who can effectively balance day-to-day purchasing responsibilities with strategic sourcing initiatives and continuous process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the purchasing of raw materials, components, parts, equipment, and services required for manufacturing operations.
* Create, issue, and manage purchase orders while ensuring accuracy, pricing, quantities, and delivery requirements.
* Utilize the company’s ERP system to manage purchasing activities, inventory levels, material requirements, supplier information, and purchase orders.
* Review MRP/ERP reports and production requirements to determine purchasing needs and timing.
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate material availability to support production schedules while minimizing excess inventory.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times, and other purchasing agreements.
* Identify and evaluate potential new suppliers based on cost, quality, capacity, delivery, and overall performance.
* Monitor supplier performance and address issues involving quality, delivery, pricing, shortages, and discrepancies.
* Work closely with Production, Engineering, Quality, Operations, and Accounting to ensure material requirements are met.
* Review and analyze supplier quotes and make purchasing decisions based on cost, quality, lead time, and production requirements.
* Support cost-reduction initiatives, including competitive bidding, supplier negotiations, alternative sourcing, and process improvements.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier information, pricing, and inventory data within the ERP system.
* Assist with forecasting and long-term material planning.
* Identify potential supply-chain risks and develop contingency plans when necessary.
* Resolve invoice, receiving, purchase order, and material discrepancies.
* Track and report purchasing metrics, including supplier performance, cost savings, inventory levels, and on-time delivery.
* Ensure purchasing activities comply with company policies and established procedures.

Qualifications

* 5+ years of purchasing/buying experience within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing supply chains, materials, components, and production processes.
* Proven experience using an ERP/MRP system for purchasing and inventory management.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience managing supplier relationships and evaluating supplier performance.
* Ability to read and interpret purchase specifications, bills of materials, drawings, and other technical documentation.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple projects and work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, or a related field.
* Experience with ERP systems such as Epicor, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, NetSuite, or similar platforms.
* Experience with MRP, inventory planning, forecasting, and demand planning.
* Experience purchasing engineered components, fabricated parts, raw materials, or other manufacturing-related products.
* APICS/ASCM certification or related supply chain certification.

What We’re Looking For

The successful candidate will be a hands-on, analytical purchasing professional who understands how purchasing decisions directly impact production, inventory, profitability, and customer delivery. The ideal candidate is comfortable working within an ERP system, building strong supplier relationships, negotiating effectively, and taking ownership of material availability from purchase order through delivery.

I want to hire you… and pay you a lot of money.

But this role isn't for most media buyers.

If you're a senior media buyer based in the U.S. who is already actively managing accounts spending **7 figures per month on Meta and/or Google**, keep reading.

Because if you're genuinely elite at media buying, obsessed with performance, and want to operate at a scale where small improvements can have massive impact, this could be the opportunity you're looking for.

We don't need someone to simply maintain what we've built.

**We want someone who can help us make it significantly better.**

At our scale, media buying and creative strategy cannot operate separately.

You'll know our best-performing ads.

You'll know our best-performing angles.

You'll know which concepts are starting to gain traction.

And you'll make sure we capitalize on them.

That means constantly thinking:

**“This is working here why aren't we running it here, here, and here?”**

**“This angle is crushing on Meta let's test it on YouTube.”**

**“This state-specific concept is working let's build it for every relevant market.”**

**“We're relying too heavily on UGC here let's expand our creative diversity.”**

**“This angle is starting to work creative team needs to build 10 more variations before everyone else catches it.”**

You'll bridge the gap between **performance data and the creative team.**

The creative team should always know what's working, what's starting to work, what's getting fatigued, and what we need more of.

### **3. Underperforming Markets**

When a state isn't producing enough volume, your job isn't simply to say:

*"Performance is bad."*

Your job is to figure out **why.**

Is it creative?

Campaign structure?

Budget allocation?

Lack of creative diversity?

A winning angle we haven't brought over from another market?

Platform mix?

Audience?

Offer?

Landing page?

Then build and execute a plan to improve it.

We want problem solvers, not reporters.

### **4. Media Buying Operations**

You'll help own the operational side of running advertising at scale.

That includes:

* Weekly and monthly spend planning and pacing
* Cross-platform and state-level budget allocation
* Campaign launches
* Creative launches across Meta and Google
* Key media buying Google Sheets and reporting
* Performance tracking
* Testing frameworks
* Campaign structure
* Account organization
* Making sure nothing falls through the cracks

You'll know how our campaigns are structured and understand what is happening across the accounts without needing someone else to explain it to you.

You'll be expected to check campaigns over weekends when necessary to ensure:

description:
The Senior Manager, Supplier Relationship Management & Operations leads ABM's Supplier Onboarding and Supplier Enablement functions and is accountable for an efficient, compliant, and scalable supplier lifecycle from onboarding through ongoing enablement and support.

The role provides strategic and operational leadership across Coupa SIM, supplier enablement, supplier master data, catalogs, supplier support, relationship management, and related integrations. It owns service delivery, team performance, capacity, process governance, SLAs, supplier experience, risk, and continuous improvement while partnering with Procurement, Purchasing Operations, AP, MDM, Technology, Finance, Risk, Legal, and business stakeholders.

The role also owns the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) implementation and ongoing operational administration, including contract loading, repository and metadata quality, workflow and process adoption, lifecycle maintenance, and coordination with Legal, Procurement, Technology, and business stakeholders.

**\\*\\*Experience with Coupa or a comparable procurement platform; Coupa SIM, CSP, catalogs, supplier master data, integrations, and transformation experience is required.**

**Benefit Information:**

ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit Employee Benefits | Staff & Management

**Pay**: $110,000.00 - $145,000.00/yr

The pay listed is the hourly range or the hourly rate for this position. A specific offer will vary based on the applicant’s experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data.

* Lead Supplier Onboarding and Supplier Enablement with end-to-end accountability for supplier lifecycle operations, service delivery, team performance, and supplier experience.

* Oversee supplier onboarding, maintenance, reactivation, deactivation, and profile changes through Coupa SIM and related systems in accordance with ABM policies and controls.

* Govern Supplier Enablement activities, including Form 1/Form 2 review and approval, CSP adoption, supplier communications, and enablement support.

* Manage workload, staffing, prioritization, capacity, cross-training, backup coverage, SLAs, escalation paths, quality standards, and team performance.

* Oversee hosted catalog governance and PunchOut enablement in partnership with suppliers, Category Management, and Technology.

* Partner with MDM and Technology to resolve Coupa, MDM, OCF, and related integration failures; drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

* Lead supplier support channels, including ServiceNow, supplier mailbox inquiries, Supplier Office Hours, Supplier Town Halls, training, and self-service resources.

* Establish and monitor KPIs for cycle time, SIM processing, ticket volume/aging, backlog, SLA performance, escalations, data quality, and productivity.

* Serve as the senior escalation point for complex supplier, system, and relationship issues and coordinate cross-functional resolution.

* Develop team capability and drive process standardization, documentation, automation, AI, self-service, transformation initiatives, testing, and risk mitigation.

* Lead the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) implementation, including requirements, process design, testing, deployment, training, adoption, and transition to steady-state operations.

* Manage the CLM repository and contract lifecycle by loading executed contracts, maintaining contract records and metadata, monitoring renewals, expirations, obligations, and key dates, and coordinating updates with Legal, Procurement, Technology, and business stakeholders.

* Leads Supplier Relationship Management and Supplier Operations supporting an enterprise supplier base exceeding 8,000 active vendors.

* Provides supervisory leadership across supplier onboarding and enablement resources, including performance management, workload allocation, capacity planning, and development.

* Owns high-volume supplier intake, ServiceNow support, supplier lifecycle processing, catalog enablement, integration issue resolution, and supplier-facing support.

* Accountable for SLAs, cycle times, backlog, quality, controls, business continuity, continuous improvement, and cross-functional outcomes.

* Owns CLM implementation and ongoing administration, including contract loading, repository accuracy, lifecycle data maintenance, renewal and expiration visibility, controls, and user support.

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Procurement, Business Administration, Finance, Operations, Information Systems, or related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

* 7-10+ years of progressive experience in procurement operations, supplier relationship management, supplier onboarding/enablement, Source-to-Pay, Procure-to-Pay, or related operations.

* 3-5+ years of people leadership experience with accountability for operational performance, workload management, and complex cross-functional processes.

Delivering hyperscale data centers at scale requires materials, equipment, and services to arrive at the right place, at the right time, and in alignment with demanding construction schedules. * Develop and execute the project procurement strategy in alignment with the construction schedule, budget, project objectives, and customer requirements.

The Regional Purchasing Manager — Central is responsible for supporting CardVault by Tom Brady stores throughout the assigned Central region with all aspects of in-store card purchasing, while also actively sourcing and purchasing inventory for the company.

The Regional Purchasing Manager — Central will have primary purchasing responsibility for the following CardVault locations:

* Chicago

* Mall of America

* St. Louis

* Kansas City

* Indianapolis

* Austin

* Dallas

* Pittsburgh

  

Additional stores or markets may be added to the assigned region based on future store openings, organizational needs, geographic alignment, or other business considerations. While the assigned Central region will remain the position’s primary focus, the Regional Purchasing Manager may also be asked to provide purchasing support to other CardVault locations, events, or markets as business needs require.

*Representative but not exhaustive. Other duties may be assigned.*

* Serve as the primary day-to-day purchasing resource for CardVault stores within the assigned Central region.

* Build strong working relationships with store managers, district managers, keyholders, and approved purchasers throughout the region.

The Buyer is responsible for procuring quality goods and services that meet LATICRETE’s cost, quality, and delivery objectives, while maintaining appropriate inventory levels and ensuring compliance with company policies. The Buyer collaborates with Planning, Operations, Finance, and Supplier partners to execute procurement plans driven by demand signals and MRP, and to proactively escalate issues that could impact supply.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.*

**Inventory Management (35%):**

* Implement stocking models considering factors such as demand forecasts, lead times, logistics, and supplier capabilities.
* Conduct regular reviews and adjustments to stocking models based on changing demand patterns to maintain optimal inventory levels.
* Support inventory risk identification (e.g., potential stockouts, long lead time exposure) and communicate mitigation options to Planning and Procurement leadership.
* Review and maintain purchasing master data (e.g., lead times, order multiples, safety stock) and planning parameters to reflect current supply and supplier capabilities.

**Procurement (30%):**

* Execute MRP action messages and translate approved demand signals into timely purchase actions to maintain targeted inventory and service levels.
* Create and manage purchase orders in line with cost, quality, and delivery targets; track orders and coordinate inbound logistics to meet need dates.
* Confirm acknowledgments and update stakeholders on order status and changes.
* Resolve day-to-day supplier issues (price, delivery, invoice discrepancies), escalating to management as needed.

**Supplier Relationship Management (10%):**

* Cultivate and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with suppliers to ensure reliability, quality, and timeliness of deliveries.
* Capture delivery/quality issues and escalate to suppliers and internal management as appropriate.
* Support data collection for supplier performance tracking (OTIF, responsiveness), coordinating with Procurement leadership for periodic reviews.
* Champion ethical sourcing practices and sustainability initiatives within the supply chain, working closely with suppliers to promote responsible sourcing and environmental stewardship.

**Collaboration (25%):**

* Partner with Demand Planning on forecast signals
* Coordinate with Operations, Warehousing/Logistics, and Finance to align purchasing activity with production schedules and cash flow considerations.
* Contribute to clear, timely status updates to enable cross-functional decision making

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. * Strong understanding of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems and data parameters.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions.

The Buyer is responsible for procuring quality goods and services that meet LATICRETE’s cost, quality, and delivery objectives, while maintaining appropriate inventory levels and ensuring compliance with company policies. The Buyer collaborates with Planning, Operations, Finance, and Supplier partners to execute procurement plans driven by demand signals and MRP, and to proactively escalate issues that could impact supply.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.*

**Inventory Management (35%):**

* Implement stocking models considering factors such as demand forecasts, lead times, logistics, and supplier capabilities.
* Conduct regular reviews and adjustments to stocking models based on changing demand patterns to maintain optimal inventory levels.
* Support inventory risk identification (e.g., potential stockouts, long lead time exposure) and communicate mitigation options to Planning and Procurement leadership.
* Review and maintain purchasing master data (e.g., lead times, order multiples, safety stock) and planning parameters to reflect current supply and supplier capabilities.

**Procurement (30%):**

* Execute MRP action messages and translate approved demand signals into timely purchase actions to maintain targeted inventory and service levels.
* Create and manage purchase orders in line with cost, quality, and delivery targets; track orders and coordinate inbound logistics to meet need dates.
* Confirm acknowledgments and update stakeholders on order status and changes.
* Resolve day-to-day supplier issues (price, delivery, invoice discrepancies), escalating to management as needed.

**Supplier Relationship Management (10%):**

* Cultivate and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with suppliers to ensure reliability, quality, and timeliness of deliveries.
* Capture delivery/quality issues and escalate to suppliers and internal management as appropriate.
* Support data collection for supplier performance tracking (OTIF, responsiveness), coordinating with Procurement leadership for periodic reviews.
* Champion ethical sourcing practices and sustainability initiatives within the supply chain, working closely with suppliers to promote responsible sourcing and environmental stewardship.

**Collaboration (25%):**

* Partner with Demand Planning on forecast signals
* Coordinate with Operations, Warehousing/Logistics, and Finance to align purchasing activity with production schedules and cash flow considerations.
* Contribute to clear, timely status updates to enable cross-functional decision making

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. * Strong understanding of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems and data parameters.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions.

The Buyer is responsible for procuring quality goods and services that meet LATICRETE’s cost, quality, and delivery objectives, while maintaining appropriate inventory levels and ensuring compliance with company policies. The Buyer collaborates with Planning, Operations, Finance, and Supplier partners to execute procurement plans driven by demand signals and MRP, and to proactively escalate issues that could impact supply.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.*

**Inventory Management (35%):**

* Implement stocking models considering factors such as demand forecasts, lead times, logistics, and supplier capabilities.
* Conduct regular reviews and adjustments to stocking models based on changing demand patterns to maintain optimal inventory levels.
* Support inventory risk identification (e.g., potential stockouts, long lead time exposure) and communicate mitigation options to Planning and Procurement leadership.
* Review and maintain purchasing master data (e.g., lead times, order multiples, safety stock) and planning parameters to reflect current supply and supplier capabilities.

**Procurement (30%):**

* Execute MRP action messages and translate approved demand signals into timely purchase actions to maintain targeted inventory and service levels.
* Create and manage purchase orders in line with cost, quality, and delivery targets; track orders and coordinate inbound logistics to meet need dates.
* Confirm acknowledgments and update stakeholders on order status and changes.
* Resolve day-to-day supplier issues (price, delivery, invoice discrepancies), escalating to management as needed.

**Supplier Relationship Management (10%):**

* Cultivate and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with suppliers to ensure reliability, quality, and timeliness of deliveries.
* Capture delivery/quality issues and escalate to suppliers and internal management as appropriate.
* Support data collection for supplier performance tracking (OTIF, responsiveness), coordinating with Procurement leadership for periodic reviews.
* Champion ethical sourcing practices and sustainability initiatives within the supply chain, working closely with suppliers to promote responsible sourcing and environmental stewardship.

**Collaboration (25%):**

* Partner with Demand Planning on forecast signals
* Coordinate with Operations, Warehousing/Logistics, and Finance to align purchasing activity with production schedules and cash flow considerations.
* Contribute to clear, timely status updates to enable cross-functional decision making

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. * Strong understanding of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems and data parameters.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions.

The Buyer is responsible for procuring quality goods and services that meet LATICRETE’s cost, quality, and delivery objectives, while maintaining appropriate inventory levels and ensuring compliance with company policies. The Buyer collaborates with Planning, Operations, Finance, and Supplier partners to execute procurement plans driven by demand signals and MRP, and to proactively escalate issues that could impact supply.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.*

**Inventory Management (35%):**

* Implement stocking models considering factors such as demand forecasts, lead times, logistics, and supplier capabilities.
* Conduct regular reviews and adjustments to stocking models based on changing demand patterns to maintain optimal inventory levels.
* Support inventory risk identification (e.g., potential stockouts, long lead time exposure) and communicate mitigation options to Planning and Procurement leadership.
* Review and maintain purchasing master data (e.g., lead times, order multiples, safety stock) and planning parameters to reflect current supply and supplier capabilities.

**Procurement (30%):**

* Execute MRP action messages and translate approved demand signals into timely purchase actions to maintain targeted inventory and service levels.
* Create and manage purchase orders in line with cost, quality, and delivery targets; track orders and coordinate inbound logistics to meet need dates.
* Confirm acknowledgments and update stakeholders on order status and changes.
* Resolve day-to-day supplier issues (price, delivery, invoice discrepancies), escalating to management as needed.

**Supplier Relationship Management (10%):**

* Cultivate and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with suppliers to ensure reliability, quality, and timeliness of deliveries.
* Capture delivery/quality issues and escalate to suppliers and internal management as appropriate.
* Support data collection for supplier performance tracking (OTIF, responsiveness), coordinating with Procurement leadership for periodic reviews.
* Champion ethical sourcing practices and sustainability initiatives within the supply chain, working closely with suppliers to promote responsible sourcing and environmental stewardship.

**Collaboration (25%):**

* Partner with Demand Planning on forecast signals
* Coordinate with Operations, Warehousing/Logistics, and Finance to align purchasing activity with production schedules and cash flow considerations.
* Contribute to clear, timely status updates to enable cross-functional decision making

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. * Strong understanding of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems and data parameters.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions.

The Buyer is responsible for procuring quality goods and services that meet LATICRETE’s cost, quality, and delivery objectives, while maintaining appropriate inventory levels and ensuring compliance with company policies. The Buyer collaborates with Planning, Operations, Finance, and Supplier partners to execute procurement plans driven by demand signals and MRP, and to proactively escalate issues that could impact supply.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.*

**Inventory Management (35%):**

* Implement stocking models considering factors such as demand forecasts, lead times, logistics, and supplier capabilities.
* Conduct regular reviews and adjustments to stocking models based on changing demand patterns to maintain optimal inventory levels.
* Support inventory risk identification (e.g., potential stockouts, long lead time exposure) and communicate mitigation options to Planning and Procurement leadership.
* Review and maintain purchasing master data (e.g., lead times, order multiples, safety stock) and planning parameters to reflect current supply and supplier capabilities.

**Procurement (30%):**

* Execute MRP action messages and translate approved demand signals into timely purchase actions to maintain targeted inventory and service levels.
* Create and manage purchase orders in line with cost, quality, and delivery targets; track orders and coordinate inbound logistics to meet need dates.
* Confirm acknowledgments and update stakeholders on order status and changes.
* Resolve day-to-day supplier issues (price, delivery, invoice discrepancies), escalating to management as needed.

**Supplier Relationship Management (10%):**

* Cultivate and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with suppliers to ensure reliability, quality, and timeliness of deliveries.
* Capture delivery/quality issues and escalate to suppliers and internal management as appropriate.
* Support data collection for supplier performance tracking (OTIF, responsiveness), coordinating with Procurement leadership for periodic reviews.
* Champion ethical sourcing practices and sustainability initiatives within the supply chain, working closely with suppliers to promote responsible sourcing and environmental stewardship.

**Collaboration (25%):**

* Partner with Demand Planning on forecast signals
* Coordinate with Operations, Warehousing/Logistics, and Finance to align purchasing activity with production schedules and cash flow considerations.
* Contribute to clear, timely status updates to enable cross-functional decision making

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. * Strong understanding of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems and data parameters.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions.

The Buyer is responsible for procuring quality goods and services that meet LATICRETE’s cost, quality, and delivery objectives, while maintaining appropriate inventory levels and ensuring compliance with company policies. The Buyer collaborates with Planning, Operations, Finance, and Supplier partners to execute procurement plans driven by demand signals and MRP, and to proactively escalate issues that could impact supply.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.*

**Inventory Management (35%):**

* Implement stocking models considering factors such as demand forecasts, lead times, logistics, and supplier capabilities.
* Conduct regular reviews and adjustments to stocking models based on changing demand patterns to maintain optimal inventory levels.
* Support inventory risk identification (e.g., potential stockouts, long lead time exposure) and communicate mitigation options to Planning and Procurement leadership.
* Review and maintain purchasing master data (e.g., lead times, order multiples, safety stock) and planning parameters to reflect current supply and supplier capabilities.

**Procurement (30%):**

* Execute MRP action messages and translate approved demand signals into timely purchase actions to maintain targeted inventory and service levels.
* Create and manage purchase orders in line with cost, quality, and delivery targets; track orders and coordinate inbound logistics to meet need dates.
* Confirm acknowledgments and update stakeholders on order status and changes.
* Resolve day-to-day supplier issues (price, delivery, invoice discrepancies), escalating to management as needed.

**Supplier Relationship Management (10%):**

* Cultivate and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with suppliers to ensure reliability, quality, and timeliness of deliveries.
* Capture delivery/quality issues and escalate to suppliers and internal management as appropriate.
* Support data collection for supplier performance tracking (OTIF, responsiveness), coordinating with Procurement leadership for periodic reviews.
* Champion ethical sourcing practices and sustainability initiatives within the supply chain, working closely with suppliers to promote responsible sourcing and environmental stewardship.

**Collaboration (25%):**

* Partner with Demand Planning on forecast signals
* Coordinate with Operations, Warehousing/Logistics, and Finance to align purchasing activity with production schedules and cash flow considerations.
* Contribute to clear, timely status updates to enable cross-functional decision making

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. * Strong understanding of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems and data parameters.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions.

The right candidate has direct purchasing experience in a manufacturing or inventory-based environment, works comfortably in NetSuite or another MRP system, and is skilled at managing supplier performance to maintain business continuity. Key Responsibilities

Purchase Order Management  
Create, submit, update, expedite, reschedule, and close purchase orders based on the approved supply plan.  
Validate item numbers, quantities, pricing, dates, freight terms, and payment terms across NetSuite and related systems before releasing or changing orders.  
Maintain current supplier confirmations, expected receipt dates, open commitments, and order notes so purchase-order status is reliable.  
Complete other operational purchasing activities as assigned, including weekly Instacart orders.  
Material Availability and Risk Mitigation  
Review inventory, open purchase orders, production demand, and zero-to-twelve-week material coverage to identify shortages, excess exposure, and items requiring immediate action.  
Resolve shortages, past-due purchase orders, and other near-term material risks by obtaining supplier recovery dates and evaluating available options.  
Communicate risks, recovery dates, and changes to Production, Warehouse, Quality, Finance, and other affected teams.  
Escalate unresolved shortages, supplier delays, cost changes, quality concerns, inventory risks, and decisions requiring planning direction to the Planner.  
Inbound Freight and Receiving

Maintain tracking information and supporting records for inbound freight provided by suppliers and carriers.  
Resolve inbound quantity discrepancies, damages, incorrect receipts, and shipment errors with suppliers, carriers, Receiving, and Quality.  
Initiate supplier or freight claims when appropriate and follow issues through resolution.  
Invoice and Transaction Accuracy

* Identify and evaluate trends and best practices in inventory management to enhance purchasing strategies.
* Help create and enforce inventory and purchasing policies and procedures to ensure efficiency, consistency, and compliance.

* Conduct negotiations and manage contracts with suppliers to secure the best possible terms and pricing.

* Mentor teammates on inventory and purchasing procedures, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.

* Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to support decision making.

The role works with program teams, supply chain professionals, finance, and engineering to evaluate supplier pricing for reasonableness and compliance with applicable FAR/DFARS requirements. The selected candidate will also contribute to major proposal efforts, analytical tools, training materials, and standardized cost and price analysis practices.
  
  
The position serves as a subject-matter resource under the direction of the Supply Chain Cost Analysis and Financial Risk Lead and escalates complex, high-risk, or precedent setting matters for technical review and disposition.

* Assess supplier BOE estimating methodologies and cost buildup structures.

A career at Whole Foods Market is more than just the work you do- it's about your personal growth and creating meaningful change. Our purpose is to nourish people and the planet. That means improving how people eat, funding grants for school gardens, providing access to fresh and healthy food to people living within food deserts, alleviating poverty in developing countries, and so much more. Working with us means you are making a difference within your community and beyond. We aren't just a grocery store: we're world-changers. And with your help, we will continue to set the standards of excellence and revolutionize the grocery industry.

Orders, replenishes and merchandises grocery products and participate in WFM program for purchasing and promotions. Monitors inventory control and replenishes product based upon WFM ordering standards. Assists in organizing and developing promotional displays and maintaining OTS standards. All Whole Foods Market Retail jobs require ensuring a positive company image by providing courteous, friendly, and efficient service to customers and Team Members at all times. All positions must be performed in accordance with team and store Standard Operating Procedures. Further, Team Members must be prepared and able to perform the duties inherent in other Team Member job descriptions. All positions must strive to support WFM core values and goals, promote national, regional, and store programs and initiatives, and ensure adherence to all applicable health and safety regulations including Food Safety and regulatory duties required in the department.

### **Job Responsibilities**

* Completes Order Writer training
* Replenishes products through proper buying procedures.
* Orders perishable and/or non-perishable grocery products and maintains appropriate back stock levels.
* Monitors and acts upon open PO reports for both purchases and credits in an accurate and timely manner.
* Controls spoilage/shrink; participates in inventory and cycle counting.
* Completes spoilage and all other inventory management processes, sampling, temperature, and sweep worksheets as required.
* Ensures orders for product are timely and accurate to monitor inventory turns.
* Oversees customer special order procedure.
* Analyzes and controls product transfers, waste, and spoilage.
* Supports leadership in conducting inventories.
* Maintains financial profitability by meeting and exceeding purchasing and sales targets.
* Arrives to work station on time, appropriately groomed, dressed and ready to work; works all scheduled shifts and attends required trainings and meetings.
* Provides excellent customer service, addresses needs of customers in a timely and effective manner and models suggestive selling techniques; answers phones and pages promptly and courteously.
* Maximizes sales potential through effective and proper procedures for prepping, storing, rotating, stocking, and merchandising product.
* Follows and complies, or ensures compliance, with established procedures, including Weights and Measures, health and sanitation, and safe work practices.
* Maintains, or ensures maintenance of, a clean and sanitary working and shopping environment; maintains equipment in accordance with WFM cleanliness and safety standards.
* Performs opening, mid, and closing duties as assigned; ensures accuracy of signs and pricing.
* Immediately reports safety hazards and violations.
* Performs other duties as assigned by store, regional, or national leadership.

### **Job Skills**

* Comprehensive knowledge of grocery products.
* Working knowledge and application of all grocery merchandising expectations.
* Ability to educate team on product knowledge and convey enthusiasm.
* Strong basic math skills.
* Knowledge and ability to use computer programs such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and ordering systems.
* Strong to excellent communication skills and willingness to work as part of a team.
* Ability to deliver information in a clear and respectable manner to fellow Team Members, customers, and vendors.
* Ability to meet customer service expectations and standards in all interactions with customers, vendors, and Team Members.
* Ability to follow directions and procedures; effective time management and organization skills.
* Passion for natural foods and the mission of Whole Foods Market.
* Strong work ethic and ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a sense of urgency.
* Understanding of and compliance with WFM quality goals.

### **Experience**

* 12+ months retail experience.

### **Physical Requirements/Working Conditions**

* Must be able to lift 50 pounds.
* In an 8-hour work day: standing/walking 6-8 hours.
* Hand use: single grasping, fine manipulation, pushing and pulling.
* Work requires the following motions: bending, twisting, squatting and reaching.
* Exposure to FDA approved cleaning chemicals.
* Exposure to temperatures: <32 degrees Fahrenheit (freezing), 32-40 degrees Fahrenheit (refrigerators), >90 d

**About W. Silver Recycling**

W. Silver Recycling, Inc. (WSR) operates a highly complex, fast-paced B2B by-products management model servicing major manufacturers and industrial sources across the US and Mexico. We are driven by our Hedgehog concept: to be the most efficient scrap operator in North America.

We run processing facilities across along the US-Mexico border, in Mexico, and are headquartered in El Paso, TX. Efficiency is not a slogan here. It shows up in how we run our equipment, how we manage cost per ton, and in the expectation that people own the results of their area.

**The Role:**

The MRO Purchasing Agent keeps our plants and equipment supplied — parts, consumables, fluids, shop supplies and outside services — at the right cost and on the right timeline.

Most of this work is steady and routine: knowing what the maintenance teams need before they ask, keeping stocked items on the shelf, holding vendors to their quoted pricing and lead times, and finding better ways to buy the same part.

Some days will involve a machine down and a part that has to move today. Those days matter, but they are not the job. The job is making those days rare and keeping maintenance spend under control the rest of the time.

**What You Will Do:**

**Day-to-day purchasing.** Process requisitions and purchase orders for maintenance parts, consumables, lubricants and fluids, shop supplies, PPE and outside repair services across our facilities.

**Cost control.** Track what we pay item by item, compare vendors, consolidate spend where it earns better pricing, and bring cost reduction ideas forward without being asked.

**Inventory.** Set and maintain min/max levels on wear parts and consumables so the shelf has what the mechanics need without tying up cash in parts we do not use.

**Vendor management.** Build and hold relationships with suppliers on both sides of the border. Hold them to quoted pricing, lead times and quality, and develop local machining, hose, cylinder rebuild and fabrication sources in the El Paso/Juárez region.

**Equipment support.** Source parts for mobile equipment (material handlers, loaders, excavators), stationary processing equipment (shears, balers, shredders), hydraulic systems and diesel-powered units, working directly with mechanics and plant managers on specifications.

**Records and reporting.** Keep purchase, receipt and parts usage records accurate in our systems, and report monthly on MRO spend by facility and by equipment.

**Larger purchases.** Support quoting on major repairs and capital items.

What We Are Looking For

**Experience.** Three or more years in purchasing or supply chain in an industrial setting — heavy equipment fleets, manufacturing, maquiladora operations, mining, construction or recycling.

**Mechanical understanding.** Enough to hold a real conversation with a mechanic or a vendor about a part, read a parts diagram, and recognize when a quote does not match what was asked for.

**Language.** Fully bilingual in English and Spanish, in writing and on the phone.

**Systems.** Comfortable working in an ERP and a maintenance system for purchase orders, inventory and spend reporting. AI tools.

**Habits.** Organized and persistent. Follows up, closes loops, and keeps commitments to the plants.

**What Success Looks Like in Year One:**

● The mechanics get what they need without chasing you.

● MRO spend per ton comes down, and you can show where and why.

● Fewer emergency buys and less expedited freight.

● A vendor base that answers the phone and honors its quotes.

**Business Description:**

ITW Shakeproof serves major automotive and industrial OEMs and their tier suppliers with metal, cold-headed fasteners totaling approximately $210M in revenue. In addition to ITW’s industry leading research and development capabilities, ITW Shakeproof enhances our customers’ competitive advantage by:

  

* Maintaining advanced engineering and manufacturing facilities in North America.
* Exchanging products, process, and benchmarking information with sister units worldwide.
* Continually improving processes, material, and designs to ensure every product exceeds customer specifications while providing unparalleled value.

**Job Description:**

ITW Shakeproof is seeking a **Tool Room Buyer** who is responsible for direct oversight and management of the Machesney Park Plant Tool Room. The Tooling Buyer is responsible for sourcing, purchasing, expediting, and managing tooling and related supplies required to support fastener manufacturing operations. This position works closely with Engineering, Tool Room, Production, Quality, Maintenance, and outside suppliers to ensure the timely availability of tooling that meets required specifications, quality standards, cost objectives, and production schedules.

The Tool Buyer will have particular responsibility for tooling used in cold heading, forming, threading, secondary operations, and inspection processes. The role requires strong purchasing, supplier-management, technical interpretation, and organizational skills, along with the ability to respond quickly to changing production requirements.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

### **Tooling Procurement**

* Purchase production tooling including **dies, punches, pins, inserts, knockouts, cutters, thread rolls, taps, drills, carbide tooling, gauges, and other manufacturing tooling**.
* Review purchase requisitions, engineering drawings, specifications, tooling requirements, and historical purchasing information before placing orders.
* Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations based on price, quality, lead time, capability, and total cost.
* Create and maintain purchase orders and ensure accurate pricing, quantities, revisions, delivery dates, and specifications.
* Monitor open tooling orders and proactively expedite critical items to prevent production interruptions.
* Coordinate emergency tooling requirements when breakdowns, excessive wear, quality issues, or unexpected demand threaten production schedules.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities through competitive bidding, alternative sourcing, blanket orders, volume agreements, standardization, and supplier negotiations.

### **Supplier Management**

* Develop and maintain effective relationships with tooling manufacturers, machine shops, carbide suppliers, gauge suppliers, and other key vendors.
* Evaluate supplier performance related to **quality, delivery, responsiveness, lead time, and cost**.
* Work with suppliers to resolve late deliveries, incorrect tooling, quality concerns, invoice discrepancies, and other performance issues.
* Identify and qualify alternate suppliers to reduce single-source risk and improve supply continuity.
* Support supplier negotiations and sourcing strategies for high-use and critical tooling.
* Coordinate tooling repair, rework, sharpening, recoating, and refurbishment when economically appropriate.

### **Manufacturing & Technical Support**

* Work closely with **Tool Room, Engineering, Production, Quality, and Maintenance** personnel to understand tooling requirements and priorities.
* Read and interpret tooling drawings, prints, specifications, part numbers, revisions, and basic dimensional requirements.
* Develop an understanding of tooling used in **cold heading, cold forming, thread rolling, machining, trimming, pointing, and secondary operations**.
* Ensure suppliers receive current drawings and revision information when sourcing custom tooling.
* Assist Engineering and Manufacturing in sourcing tooling for new-product launches, process changes, and continuous-improvement projects.
* Support resolution of tooling-related production issues through communication with internal stakeholders and suppliers.
* Maintain awareness of tooling lead times and communicate potential shortages or production risks to appropriate personnel.

### **Inventory & Cost Control**

* Help establish appropriate inventory levels for frequently used, long-lead-time, and production-critical tooling.
* Review tooling usage and purchasing history to identify opportunities to improve stocking strategies.
* Monitor excessive tooling usage, unusual purchasing patterns, and significant cost changes.
* Assist in developing **min/max, reorder point, safety stock, and/or Kanban systems** for commonly used tooling.

**Requisition ID**: 1873  
**Position Location:** Fairfax, VA or Sterling, VA  
**Position Reports To**: Senior Manager, Supply Chain  
**Supervises Others:** No

At Trident Systems Space Electronic Systems (SES) division, we believe in the power of using strong engineering principles to drive innovation and solve complex problems. We foster a culture of rigorous engineering and continuous improvement, leveraging the full knowledge of our organization through collaborative product development processes that include design and peer reviews. We combine our expertise in space electronics with right-sized development processes to create innovative, high-performance space-based electronic systems that meet our customers' evolving needs.

We are a mission partner supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, and Civil space customers. We develop complex, radiation effects mitigated, designs that balance competing requirements in modern space programs, delivering cutting-edge solutions that enable our customers to achieve more in space.

**Position Summary**

The Buyer is responsible for procuring electronic components, mechanical parts, outside services, and other assigned materials required to support production and program execution. This role converts material requirements into compliant purchasing actions, manages purchase orders through delivery, and works cross-functionally with Material Planning, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and Program Management to meet cost, quality, and schedule commitments. The Buyer II maintains accurate ERP data, drives supplier performance, and resolves shortages and delivery issues in a regulated aerospace and defense environment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Procure electronic components, mechanical parts, outside services, and other assigned materials required to support production, engineering, and program needs.
* Create and manage purchase orders, requests for quote, and related documentation from requisition through closeout, including order acknowledgments, date changes, cancellations, returns, and discrepancy resolution.
* Review material requirements, shortage signals, supplier lead times, and delivery commitments in ERP or MRP and take action to support build schedules and program priorities.
* Expedite, de-expedite, and reschedule orders as needed to support production schedules, inventory objectives, and cash management goals.
* Obtain quotes, analyze pricing and lead times, negotiate within delegated authority, and recommend sourcing decisions that balance cost, quality, and delivery.
* Build and maintain supplier relationships and monitor on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, and corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate purchasing and supplier data in ERP systems, including pricing, lead times, order status, promise dates, and other transactional data.
* Partner with Material Planning, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and Finance to resolve shortages, nonconformances, supplier performance issues, and schedule changes.
* Support compliance with company procedures and applicable customer and regulatory requirements, including FAR or DFARS flow downs and quality system requirements, as applicable.
* Prepare and communicate open-order status, supplier risk, past-due exposure, and other procurement metrics to leadership and program teams.
* Manage multiple priorities, follow through on commitments, and work independently with limited supervision in a fast-paced environment.
* Execute work in compliance with company procedures and contractual requirements.
* Support occasional travel or off-site work, as needed.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Finance, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum 2 years of purchasing or procurement experience in a manufacturing, aerospace and defense, electronics, or similarly regulated environment.
* Experience managing purchase orders, supplier communications, and order execution in an ERP or MRP environment.
* Working knowledge of material requirements planning, inventory drivers, lead-time management, and shortage resolution.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, especially Excel, and the ability to analyze data, maintain accurate records, and communicate status clearly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience procuring electronic components, printed circuit board assemblies, machined parts, cable assemblies, or outside processing and services.
* Experience in government contracting and familiarity with FAR or DFARS, counterfeit parts controls, and AS9100D or ISO9001 quality environments.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV, Business Central, or comparable ERP systems.
* Experience supporting space, aerospace, defense, or low-volume, high-mix manufacturing operations.

**STS Aerospace** in Laconia, NH is searching for a **Buyer -OSP** to join the team. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Manage all aspects of the requisitions and purchasing process for assigned commodities (MRO, OSP, rubber, work transfers, etc.).

* Communicate proactively with requestors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders on order status, risks, and changes.

job_title: NEW* Procurement Manager - Plant Operational Excellence (National/Relo)
description:
**Relocate to the rolling hills of northwest New Jersey, just outside the New York metro, and join one of the world's leading aerospace manufacturers, full relocation covered, top-of-market compensation, and a seat at the table on a 75+ year legacy of turbine engine innovation.**

This is a rare chance to join our client, a globally recognized aerospace manufacturer, a company that has spent 75+ years pushing the boundaries of turbine engine technology. Consistently ranked among the world's best employers, this publicly traded organization backs that reputation with a culture that genuinely prioritizes its people.

**What's in it for you?**

* Stability and momentum, a growing public company with deep industry leadership
* Benefits that start on day one, premium health coverage and a 9% 401(k) match, one of the strongest in the industry
* Employer-funded retirement savings contribution each pay period
* A workplace culture built around collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement
* Structured development programs to help you grow into your next role
* On-site fitness center access

**Relocation: We'll get you here.** This role comes with a full relocation package, moving expenses, temporary housing, and transition support, to bring the best candidate to our client's flagship Northern New Jersey facility, not just the closest one. Whether you're in Pittsburgh, Wichita, Charlotte, or anywhere in between, if you've got the procurement chops to run plant operations for a global aerospace leader, we want to talk.

**Job Summary:**

The selected candidate will report to the Plant Manager and provide managerial and leadership support to the Procurement and Supply Chain Team to ensure Business Unit goals are met through the execution of procurement strategies, including securing supply, cost savings, process optimization, and supplier risk mitigation. The overall goal is to support the production schedule while obtaining the best achievable value for supplies and services while maintaining compliance with company procedures.

**Responsibilities:**

* Directly responsible for overall Plant procurement operations, including direct, indirect, and Capital spend
* Provide guidance and leadership to Plant Procurement Specialists and Supply Chain Planners
* Collaborate with the value stream (Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Finance) to align procurement strategies with Plant and BU goals
* Share savings targets with Location Management, Category Management, and stakeholders
* Manage supplier sourcing, negotiations, contracting, and execution of agreements
* Monitor supplier performance and resolve issues as they arise
* Review Plant Procurement metrics and drive action to hit Plant and BU targets
* Ensure ERP-related procurement processes are executed successfully, including system enhancement implementations
* Responsible for raw material forecasting, inventory management, cost management, and BOM issue research
* Oversee ERP item and raw material transactional activity, including cycle count program monitoring
* Manage project-related teams and plant procurement and supply chain initiatives

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, Accounting, Data Science/Analytics, Economics, or Engineering
* Minimum 6 years' experience in Procurement or Supply Chain
* Knowledge of procurement and financial compliance best practices (Sarbanes-Oxley, UCC Laws, Import/Export Laws)
* Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.; visa sponsorship not available
* Role involves access to export-controlled items; offer contingent on ability to lawfully obtain access

**Preferred:**

* Procurement experience in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
* Ability to write and negotiate complex contracts
* Oracle or similar Enterprise Business System experience
* Willingness to be on the shop floor regularly
* Strong ethics, integrity, and audit/compliance orientation

Our goal is to provide reliable, competitive, one-stop hardware solutions that help our customers improve operational efficiency and profitability.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented **IT Hardware Buyer / Purchasing Specialist** to join our procurement team.

In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing, evaluating, purchasing, and managing enterprise IT hardware and components. You will work closely with our Sales and Operations teams to respond quickly to customer requirements, identify competitive sourcing opportunities, develop and maintain supplier relationships, and ensure a reliable and timely supply of products.

**JOB SUMMARY**
  
The purpose of this job is to purchase materials and supplies; to book training and accommodations; and to process accounts payable for both the Sheriff’s Office and the Detention Center under the supervision of the Sheriff’s Finance Manager. This class with also be backup for the Finance Manager. This class plans, organizes and implements programs (fixed assets, project accounting, etc.) within major organizational policies.
  
  
This position works independently, under limited supervision, reporting major activities through periodic meetings.

**Duties**
----------

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**
  
Performs advanced and complex work in the procurement of goods and services for both the Sheriff’s Office and the Detention Center; maintains contacts with vendors for the procurement of goods, services and supplies; assists supervisors with locating capable vendors for services and supplies; and negotiates with vendors to resolve purchasing issues or for price breaks.
  
  
Acts as a backup in the absence of the Sheriff’s office Finance Manager.
  
  
Assists in the preparation of the Sheriff’s Office and Detention Center annual department budgets; monitors and reviews expenditures and unencumbered balances; reviews and evaluates department operating and capital budget expenditures and variations; and evaluates proposals and budget requests.
  
  
Audits fees that have been collected.
  
  
Processes accounts payable for assigned accounts; communicates with vendors and County personnel/officials regarding invoices; resolves discrepancies and expedites the accounts payable process as necessary; generates accounts payable checks; and processes voided checks.
  
  
Assists in formal bid solicitations and other special projects.
  
  
Audits and processes billings, expenditures and other accounts payable transaction documents; submits department revenue to the Treasurer’s Office.
  
  
Maintains accurate documentation of transactions and current status of accounts.
  
  
Prepares periodic reports as required by the Sheriff and his/her Command Staff.
  
  
Makes travel/training arrangements for the Sheriff’s Office and the Detention Center employees.
  
  
Verifies available funds for department purchase requests.
  
  
Communicates with vendors as necessary to expedite deliveries; resolves shipping/invoicing discrepancies and problems with product quality.
  
  
Reviews and posts payments to appropriate accounts; verifies account balances.
  
  
Provides outside auditors with proper documentation of accounting transactions.
  
  
Assists in reconciling bank statements and accounts.
  
  
Verifies the accuracy and completeness of accounting records and reports prepared by co-workers and/or received from other departments.
  
  
Verifies reimbursements from other vendors (training refunds and reimbursements; hotel room cancellations).
  
  
Assists in managing the use and maintenance of the department’s computer systems and software.
  
  
Receives and responds to inquiries, concerns, complaints and requests for assistance in areas of responsibility.
  
  
Purchases and maintains adequate inventory of office supplies.
  
  
Processes, copies, indexes, files, transmits and/or maintains various financial, legal and/or administrative documents.
  
  
Performs general clerical duties as required including, but not limited to, typing reports and correspondence, copying and filing documents, entering and retrieving computer data, sending and receiving faxes, processing mail, etc.
  
  
Prepares complex and confidential correspondence, memoranda, reports, etc.
  
  
Performs other related job duties as assigned.
